3.30.s:
agastya uvāca
aśvānana mahāprājña śrutamākhyānamuttamam /
vikramo lalitādevyā viśiṣṭo varṇitastvayā //
3.30.d:
अगस्त्य उवाच
अश्वानन महाप्राज्ञ श्रुतमाख्यानमुत्तमम् ।
विक्रमो ललितादेव्या विशिष्टो वर्णितस्त्वया ॥
3.30.m: Agastya said: / O horse-faced one, O greatly wise one, the excellent narrative has been heard; / the extraordinary valour of the goddess Lalitā has been described by you.

3.30.s:
caritairanaghairdevyāḥ suprīto 'smi hayānana /
śrutā sā mahatīśaktirmantriṇīdaṇḍanāthayoḥ //
3.30.d:
चरितैरनघैर्देव्याः सुप्रीतो ऽस्मि हयानन ।
श्रुता सा महतीशक्तिर्मन्त्रिणीदण्डनाथयोः ॥
3.30.m: I am well pleased by the faultless deeds of the Goddess, O horse-faced one! / Heard, too, is the great power of Mantriṇī and Daṇḍanāthā.

3.30.s:
paścātkimakarottatra yuddhānantaramaṃbikā /
caturthadinaśarvaryāṃ vibhātāyāṃ hayānana //
3.30.d:
पश्चात्किमकरोत्तत्र युद्धानन्तरमंबिका ।
चतुर्थदिनशर्वर्यां विभातायां हयानन ॥
3.30.m: What did the Mother do there afterwards, after the battle, / when the night of the fourth day had dawned, O horse-faced one?

3.30.s:
hayagrīva uvāca
śṛṇu kumbhaja tatprājña yattayā jagadaṃbayā /
paścādācaritaṃ karma nihate bhaṇḍadānave //
3.30.d:
हयग्रीव उवाच
शृणु कुम्भज तत्प्राज्ञ यत्तया जगदंबया ।
पश्चादाचरितं कर्म निहते भण्डदानवे ॥
3.30.m: Hayagrīva said: / Hear, O pot-born one, O wise one, that deed which was performed by her, / the mother of the universe, afterwards, when the dānava Bhaṇḍa was slain:

3.30.s:
śaktīnāmakhilaṃ sainyaṃ daityayudhaśatārditam /
muhurāhlādayāmāsa locanairamṛtāplutaiḥ //
3.30.d:
शक्तीनामखिलं सैन्यं दैत्ययुधशतार्दितम् ।
मुहुराह्लादयामास लोचनैरमृताप्लुतैः ॥
3.30.m: She repeatedly delighted the entire army of the Śaktis, afflicted by hundreds of daitya weapons, / with her eyes overflowing with nectar.

3.30.s:
lalitāparameśānyāḥ kaṭākṣāmṛtadhārayā /
jahuryuddhapariśrāntiṃ śaktayaḥ prītimānasāḥ //
3.30.d:
ललितापरमेशान्याः कटाक्षामृतधारया ।
जहुर्युद्धपरिश्रान्तिं शक्तयः प्रीतिमानसाः ॥
3.30.m: Through the stream of the nectar of Lalitā Parameśānī's sidelong glance, / the Śaktis cast off the fatigue of battle, their minds filled with joy.

3.30.s:
asminnavasare devā bhaṇḍamardanatoṣitāḥ /
sarve 'pi sevituṃ prāptā brahmaviṣṇupurogamāḥ //
3.30.d:
अस्मिन्नवसरे देवा भण्डमर्दनतोषिताः ।
सर्वे ऽपि सेवितुं प्राप्ता ब्रह्मविष्णुपुरोगमाः ॥
3.30.m: At this moment, the gods, delighted by the crushing of Bhaṇḍa, / all arrived to pay homage, led by Brahmā and Viṣṇu:

3.30.s:
brahmā viṣṇuśca rudraśca śakrādyāstridaśāstathā /
ādityā vasavo rudrā marutaḥ sādhyadevatāḥ //
3.30.d:
ब्रह्मा विष्णुश्च रुद्रश्च शक्राद्यास्त्रिदशास्तथा ।
आदित्या वसवो रुद्रा मरुतः साध्यदेवताः ॥
3.30.m: Brahmā, Viṣṇu, Rudra, and the thirty gods headed by Śakra, / the Ādityas, the Vasus, the Rudras, the Maruts, the Sādhya deities,

3.30.s:
siddhāḥ kiṃpuruṣā yakṣā nirṛtyādyā niśācarāḥ /
prahlādādyā mahādaityāḥ sarve 'pyaṇḍanivāsinaḥ //
3.30.d:
सिद्धाः किंपुरुषा यक्षा निरृत्याद्या निशाचराः ।
प्रह्लादाद्या महादैत्याः सर्वे ऽप्यण्डनिवासिनः ॥
3.30.m: the Siddhas, Kimpuruṣas, Yakṣas, night-wanderers headed by Nirṛti, / the great daityas headed by Prahlāda, and all the inhabitants of the cosmic egg.

3.30.s: āgatya tuṣṭuvuḥ prītyā siṃhāsanamaheśvarīm //
3.30.d: आगत्य तुष्टुवुः प्रीत्या सिंहासनमहेश्वरीम् ॥
3.30.m: Having arrived, they praised the Great Ruler of the Throne with love.

3.30.s:
brahmādyā ūcuḥ
namonamaste jagadekanāthe namonamaḥ śrītripurābhidhāne /
namonamo bhaṇḍamahāsuraghne namo 'stu kāmeśvari vāmakeśi //
3.30.d:
ब्रह्माद्या ऊचुः
नमोनमस्ते जगदेकनाथे नमोनमः श्रीत्रिपुराभिधाने ।
नमोनमो भण्डमहासुरघ्ने नमो ऽस्तु कामेश्वरि वामकेशि ॥
3.30.m:
Brahmā and the other [gods] said:
Salutations, salutations to you, sole sovereign of the universe! Salutations, salutations to you whose name is Śrītripurā! / Salutations, salutations to you, slayer of the great Asura Bhaṇḍa! O Kāmeśvarī, O Vāmakeśī, reverence be to you!

3.30.s:
cintāmaṇe cintitadānadakṣe 'cintaye cirākārataraṅgamāle /
citrāmbare citrajagatprasūte citrākhyanitye sukhade namaste //
3.30.d:
चिन्तामणे चिन्तितदानदक्षे ऽचिन्तये चिराकारतरङ्गमाले ।
चित्राम्बरे चित्रजगत्प्रसूते चित्राख्यनित्ये सुखदे नमस्ते ॥
3.30.m: O wish-fulfilling jewel, expert in granting what is desired! Inconceivable one, garland of eternal undulating forms! / You whose garments are wonderful, who gave birth to the wondrous world, Nityā named Citrā, giver of bliss, reverence to you!

3.30.s:
mokṣaprade mugdhaśaśāṅkacūḍe mugdhasmite mohanabhedadakṣe /
mudreśvarīcarcitarājatantre mudrāpriye devi namonamaste //
3.30.d:
मोक्षप्रदे मुग्धशशाङ्कचूडे मुग्धस्मिते मोहनभेददक्षे ।
मुद्रेश्वरीचर्चितराजतन्त्रे मुद्राप्रिये देवि नमोनमस्ते ॥
3.30.m: Giver of liberation, crested with the enchanting crescent moon, having a charming smile, skilled at piercing delusion! / Sovereign of seals, anointed by royal ritual, lover of the mudrās, O Goddess, salutations, salutations to you!

3.30.s:
krūrāntakadhvaṃsini komalāṅge kopeṣu kālīṃ tanumādadhāne /
kroḍānane pālitasainyacakre kroḍīkṛtāśeṣabhaye namaste //
3.30.d:
क्रूरान्तकध्वंसिनि कोमलाङ्गे कोपेषु कालीं तनुमादधाने ।
क्रोडानने पालितसैन्यचक्रे क्रोडीकृताशेषभये नमस्ते ॥
3.30.m: Destroyer of the cruel god of death, tender-limbed, assuming the form of Kālī in your wrath! / Boar-faced one, protectress of the host of armies, who gathers all fears into your embrace, reverence to you!

3.30.s:
ṣaḍaṅgadevīparivārakṛṣṇe ṣaḍaṅgayuktaśrutivākyamṛgye /
ṣaṭcakrasaṃsthe ca ṣaḍūrmiyukte ṣaḍbhāvarūpe lalite namaste //
3.30.d:
षडङ्गदेवीपरिवारकृष्णे षडङ्गयुक्तश्रुतिवाक्यमृग्ये ।
षट्चक्रसंस्थे च षडूर्मियुक्ते षड्भावरूपे ललिते नमस्ते ॥
3.30.m: Accompanied by the retinue of the six limb-goddesses, sought after by the words of the Vedas endowed with the six aṅgas! / Stationed in the six cakras, bearing the six waves [of existence], having the form of the six states of being, O Lalitā, reverence to you!

3.30.s:
kāme śive mukhyasamastanitye kāntāsanānte kamalāyatākṣi /
kāmaprade kāmini kāmaśaṃbhoḥ kāmye kalānāmadhipe namaste //
3.30.d:
कामे शिवे मुख्यसमस्तनित्ये कान्तासनान्ते कमलायताक्षि ।
कामप्रदे कामिनि कामशंभोः काम्ये कलानामधिपे नमस्ते ॥
3.30.m: O desire, auspicious one, foremost of all Nityās, resting upon the beloved throne, having long lotus eyes! / Granting desire, loving consort of Kāmaśaṃbhu, the desirable one, mistress of the arts, reverence to you!

3.30.s:
divyauṣadhādye nagaraugharūpe divye dinādhīśasahasrakānte /
dedīpyamāne dayayā sanāthe devādhidevapramade namaste //
3.30.d:
दिव्यौषधाद्ये नगरौघरूपे दिव्ये दिनाधीशसहस्रकान्ते ।
देदीप्यमाने दयया सनाथे देवाधिदेवप्रमदे नमस्ते ॥
3.30.m: Beginning with divine herbs, embodied as an expanse of cities, divine one, radiant as a thousand suns! / Blazing forth, endowed with compassion, source of joy to the supreme Lord of gods, reverence to you!

3.30.s:
sadāṇimādyaṣṭakasevanīye sadāśivātmojjvalamañcavāse /
sabhye sadekāla yapādapūjye savitri lokasya namonamaste //
3.30.d:
सदाणिमाद्यष्टकसेवनीये सदाशिवात्मोज्ज्वलमञ्चवासे ।
सभ्ये सदेकाल यपादपूज्ये सवित्रि लोकस्य नमोनमस्ते ॥
3.30.m: Ever to be served by the eight [powers] beginning with Aṇimā, dwelling on the radiant couch that is Sadāśiva! / Graceful one, whose feet are to be worshipped in all times, mother of the world, salutations, salutations to you!

3.30.s:
brāhmīmukhairmātṛgaṇairniṣevye brahmapriye brāhmaṇabandhametri /
brahmāmṛtasrotasi rājahaṃsibrahmeśvari śrīlalite namaste //
3.30.d:
ब्राह्मीमुखैर्मातृगणैर्निषेव्ये ब्रह्मप्रिये ब्राह्मणबन्धमेत्रि ।
ब्रह्मामृतस्रोतसि राजहंसिब्रह्मेश्वरि श्रीललिते नमस्ते ॥
3.30.m: Served by the host of mothers beginning with Brāhmī, beloved of Brahmā, kin and friend to Brahmins! / Royal swan in the stream of the nectar of Brahman, supreme mistress of Brahmā, O Śrīlalitā, reverence to you!

3.30.s:
saṃkṣobhiṇīmukhyasamastamudrāsaṃsevite saṃsaraṇaprahantri /
saṃsāralīlākṛtisārasākṣi sadā namaste lalite 'dhināthe /
nitye kalāṣoḍaśakena nāmākarṣiṇyadhīśi pramathena sevye //
3.30.d:
संक्षोभिणीमुख्यसमस्तमुद्रासंसेविते संसरणप्रहन्त्रि ।
संसारलीलाकृतिसारसाक्षि सदा नमस्ते ललिते ऽधिनाथे ।
नित्ये कलाषोडशकेन नामाकर्षिण्यधीशि प्रमथेन सेव्ये ॥
3.30.m: Served by all the seals beginning with Saṃkṣobhiṇī, destroyer of worldly wandering! / Essential witness of the play of worldly existence, reverence always to you, O Lalitā, supreme ruler! / Eternal one, with the sixteen Kalās, mistress who draws names, served by the attendants of Śiva!

3.30.s:
nitye nirātaṅkadayāprapañce nīlālakaśreṇi namonamaste /
anaṅgapuṣpādibhirunnadābhiranaṅgadevībhirajasrasevye /
abhavyahantryakṣararāśirūpe hatārivarge lalite namaste //
3.30.d:
नित्ये निरातङ्कदयाप्रपञ्चे नीलालकश्रेणि नमोनमस्ते ।
अनङ्गपुष्पादिभिरुन्नदाभिरनङ्गदेवीभिरजस्रसेव्ये ।
अभव्यहन्त्र्यक्षरराशिरूपे हतारिवर्गे ललिते नमस्ते ॥
3.30.m: Eternal one, who unfold compassion free from fear, having tresses of black locks, salutations, salutations to you! / Constantly served by the proud Anaṅga goddesses beginning with Anaṅgapuṣpā! / Destroyer of misfortune, embodied as the multitude of letters, destroyer of the host of enemies, O Lalitā, reverence to you!

3.30.s:
saṃkṣobhiṇīmukhyacaturdaśārcirmālāvṛtodāramahāpradīpte /
ātmānamābibhrati vibhramāḍhye śubhrāśraye śubhrapade namaste //
3.30.d:
संक्षोभिणीमुख्यचतुर्दशार्चिर्मालावृतोदारमहाप्रदीप्ते ।
आत्मानमाबिभ्रति विभ्रमाढ्ये शुभ्राश्रये शुभ्रपदे नमस्ते ॥
3.30.m: Encircled by the fourteen radiant flames beginning with Saṃkṣobhiṇī, of noble and supreme splendor! / Upholding yourself, full of grace, resting upon purity, stationed in the pure abode, reverence to you!

3.30.s:
saśarvasiddhādi kaśaktivandye sarvajñavijñātapadāravinde /
sarvādhike sarvagate samastasiddhiprade śrīlalite namaste //
3.30.d:
सशर्वसिद्धादि कशक्तिवन्द्ये सर्वज्ञविज्ञातपदारविन्दे ।
सर्वाधिके सर्वगते समस्तसिद्धिप्रदे श्रीललिते नमस्ते ॥
3.30.m: Revered by the powers beginning with Sarvasiddhipradā, whose lotus feet are known to the all-knowing! / Transcending all, pervasive in all, bestower of all siddhis, O Śrīlalitā, reverence to you!

3.30.s:
sarvajñajātaprathamābhiranyadevī bhirapyāśritacakrabhūme /
sarvāmarākāṅkṣitapūrayitri sarvasya lokasya savitri pāhi //
3.30.d:
सर्वज्ञजातप्रथमाभिरन्यदेवी भिरप्याश्रितचक्रभूमे ।
सर्वामराकाङ्क्षितपूरयित्रि सर्वस्य लोकस्य सवित्रि पाहि ॥
3.30.m: Whose cakra domain is resorted to by the other goddesses beginning with the foremost born of Sarvajñā! / Fulfiller of the desires of all the immortals, mother of the entire world, protect [us]!

3.30.s:
vande vaśinyādikavāgvibhūte varddhiṣṇucakra dyutivāhavāhe /
balāhakaśyāmakace vaco 'bdhe varaprade suṃdari pāhi viśvam //
3.30.d:
वन्दे वशिन्यादिकवाग्विभूते वर्द्धिष्णुचक्र द्युतिवाहवाहे ।
बलाहकश्यामकचे वचो ऽब्धे वरप्रदे सुंदरि पाहि विश्वम् ॥
3.30.m: I praise you, whose powers of speech begin with Vaśinī, who bear the radiance of the expanding cakra! / Having hair dark as rainclouds, ocean of speech, grantor of boons, O beautiful one, protect the universe!

3.30.s:
bāṇādidivyāyudhasārvabhaume bhaṇḍāsurānīkavanāntadāve /
atyugratejojjvalitāṃburāśe prasevyamāne parito namaste //
3.30.d:
बाणादिदिव्यायुधसार्वभौमे भण्डासुरानीकवनान्तदावे ।
अत्युग्रतेजोज्ज्वलितांबुराशे प्रसेव्यमाने परितो नमस्ते ॥
3.30.m: Sovereign over divine weapons beginning with the arrows, a forest-fire to the forest of Asura Bhaṇḍa's army! / Ocean ignited with fierce splendor, served on every side, reverence to you!

3.30.s:
kāmeśi vajreśi bhageśyarūpe kanye kale kālavilopadakṣe /
kathāviśeṣīkṛtadaityasainye kāmeśayānte kamale namaste //
3.30.d:
कामेशि वज्रेशि भगेश्यरूपे कन्ये कले कालविलोपदक्षे ।
कथाविशेषीकृतदैत्यसैन्ये कामेशयान्ते कमले नमस्ते ॥
3.30.m: Kāmeśī, Vajreśī, possessing the form of Bhageśī, maiden, digit [of the moon], skilled at dissolving Time! / You who reduced the army of Daityas to mere tales, resting on Kāmeśvara's lap, lotus-seated one, reverence to you!

3.30.s:
bindusthite bindukalaikarūpe bindvātmike bṛṃhitacitprakāśe /
bṛhatkucaṃbhojavilolahāre bṛhatprabhāve lalite namaste //
3.30.d:
बिन्दुस्थिते बिन्दुकलैकरूपे बिन्द्वात्मिके बृंहितचित्प्रकाशे ।
बृहत्कुचंभोजविलोलहारे बृहत्प्रभावे ललिते नमस्ते ॥
3.30.m: Stationed in the bindu, of the sole form of the digit of the bindu, composed of the bindu, who magnify the light of consciousness! / With a swaying necklace upon your large lotus breasts, of vast majesty, O Lalitā, reverence to you!

3.30.s:
kāmeśvarotsaṃgasadānivāse kālātmike devi kṛtānukaṃpe /
kalpāvasānotthita kālirūpe kāmaprade kalpalate namaste //
3.30.d:
कामेश्वरोत्संगसदानिवासे कालात्मिके देवि कृतानुकंपे ।
कल्पावसानोत्थित कालिरूपे कामप्रदे कल्पलते नमस्ते ॥
3.30.m: Ever dwelling on the lap of Kāmeśvara, embodied as Time, O Goddess, full of compassion! / Having the form of Kālī arisen at the end of the kalpa, granter of desires, wishing-vine, reverence to you!

3.30.s:
savāruṇe sāṃdrasudhāṃśuśīte sāraṅgaśāvākṣi sarojavaktre /
sārasya sārasya sadaikabhūme samastavidyeśvari saṃnatiste //
3.30.d:
सवारुणे सांद्रसुधांशुशीते सारङ्गशावाक्षि सरोजवक्त्रे ।
सारस्य सारस्य सदैकभूमे समस्तविद्येश्वरि संनतिस्ते ॥
3.30.m: Joined with red wine, cool as the abundant moon, with eyes like a fawn's, lotus-faced! / Sole eternal ground of essential sweetness, mistress of all lore, salutation to you!

3.30.s:
tava prabhāveṇa cidagnijāyāṃ śrīśaṃbhunāthaprakaḍīkṛtāyāḥ /
bhaṇḍāsurādyāḥ samare pracaṇḍā hatā jagatkaṇṭakatāṃ prayātāḥ //
3.30.d:
तव प्रभावेण चिदग्निजायां श्रीशंभुनाथप्रकडीकृतायाः ।
भण्डासुराद्याः समरे प्रचण्डा हता जगत्कण्टकतां प्रयाताः ॥
3.30.m: By your power, O you who were born from the fire of consciousness and made manifest by Lord Śambhu, / the fierce Asura Bhaṇḍa and others, who had become thorns to the world, were slain in battle.

3.30.s:
navyāni sarvāṇi vapūṃṣi kṛtvā hi sāṃdrakāruṇyasudhāplavairnnaḥ /
tvayā samastaṃ bhuvanaṃ saharṣaṃ sujīvitaṃ suṃdari sabhyalabhye //
3.30.d:
नव्यानि सर्वाणि वपूंषि कृत्वा हि सांद्रकारुण्यसुधाप्लवैर्न्नः ।
त्वया समस्तं भुवनं सहर्षं सुजीवितं सुंदरि सभ्यलभ्ये ॥
3.30.m: Making all our bodies new through inundations of the nectar of deep compassion, / the entire world has been happily brought back to life by you, O beautiful one, attainable by the noble!

3.30.s:
śrīśaṃbhunāthasya mahāśayasya dvitīyatejaḥ prasarātmake yaḥ /
sthāṇvāśrame kḷptatayā viraktaḥ satīviyogena virastabhogaḥ //
3.30.d:
श्रीशंभुनाथस्य महाशयस्य द्वितीयतेजः प्रसरात्मके यः ।
स्थाण्वाश्रमे कॢप्ततया विरक्तः सतीवियोगेन विरस्तभोगः ॥
3.30.m: He who is the extension of the second splendor of the noble Lord Śambhu, / who, resolute in the hermitage of Sthāṇu, was detached and had given up pleasure through separation from Satī—

3.30.s:
tenādrivaṃśe dhṛtajanmalābhāṃ kanyāmumāṃ yojayituṃ pravṛttāḥ /
evaṃ smaraṃ preritavanta eva tasyāntikaṃ ghora tapaḥsthitasya //
3.30.d:
तेनाद्रिवंशे धृतजन्मलाभां कन्यामुमां योजयितुं प्रवृत्ताः ।
एवं स्मरं प्रेरितवन्त एव तस्यान्तिकं घोर तपःस्थितस्य ॥
3.30.m: it was to unite him with the maiden Umā, who had taken birth in the mountain family, / that [the gods] dispatched Smara to his presence as he stood performing severe austerities.

3.30.s:
tenātha vairāgyatapovighātakrodhena lālāṭakṛśānudagdhaḥ /
bhasmāvaśeṣo madanastato 'bhūttato hi bhaṇḍāsura eṣa jātaḥ //
3.30.d:
तेनाथ वैराग्यतपोविघातक्रोधेन लालाटकृशानुदग्धः ।
भस्मावशेषो मदनस्ततो ऽभूत्ततो हि भण्डासुर एष जातः ॥
3.30.m: Then, through anger at the interruption of his austerities and detachment, Madana was burned by the fire of his forehead-eye / and was reduced to ashes; and from that [heap of ashes] this Asura Bhaṇḍa was born.

3.30.s:
tato vadhastasya durāśayasya kṛto bhavatyā raṇadurmadasya /
athāsmadarthe tvatanussajātastvaṃ kāmasaṃjīvanamāśukuryāḥ //
3.30.d:
ततो वधस्तस्य दुराशयस्य कृतो भवत्या रणदुर्मदस्य ।
अथास्मदर्थे त्वतनुस्सजातस्त्वं कामसंजीवनमाशुकुर्याः ॥
3.30.m: Then the slaying of that evil-minded one, furious in battle, was accomplished by you. / Now, on our behalf, your own portion having been born, may you quickly revive Kāma.

3.30.s:
iyaṃ ratirbhartṛviyogakhinnā vaidhavyamatyantamabhavyamāpa /
punastvadutpāditakāmasaṃgādbhaviṣyati śrīlalite sanāthā //
3.30.d:
इयं रतिर्भर्तृवियोगखिन्ना वैधव्यमत्यन्तमभव्यमाप ।
पुनस्त्वदुत्पादितकामसंगाद्भविष्यति श्रीललिते सनाथा ॥
3.30.m: This Rati, afflicted by separation from her husband, has fallen into utter and dire widowhood; / through union with Kāma produced anew by you, O Śrīlalitā, she will again have a protector.

3.30.s:
tayā tu dṛṣṭena manobhavena saṃmohitaḥ pūrvavadindumauliḥ /
ciraṃ kṛtātyantamahāsaparyā tāṃ pārvatīṃ drākpariṇeṣyatīśaḥ //
3.30.d:
तया तु दृष्टेन मनोभवेन संमोहितः पूर्ववदिन्दुमौलिः ।
चिरं कृतात्यन्तमहासपर्या तां पार्वतीं द्राक्परिणेष्यतीशः ॥
3.30.m: Bewitched as before by Manobhava seen by her, the moon-crested Lord / will quickly marry that Pārvatī, who has long performed supreme worship.

3.30.s:
tayośca saṃgādbhavitā kumāraḥ samastagīrvāṇacamūvinetā /
tenaiva vīreṇa raṇe nirasya sa tārako nāma surārirājaḥ //
3.30.d:
तयोश्च संगाद्भविता कुमारः समस्तगीर्वाणचमूविनेता ।
तेनैव वीरेण रणे निरस्य स तारको नाम सुरारिराजः ॥
3.30.m: And from their union Kumāra will be born, the commander of the entire army of the gods; / by that very hero, that king of the enemies of the gods named Tāraka, defeated in battle,

3.30.s:
yo bhaṇḍadaityasya durāśayasya mitraṃ sa lokatrayadhūmaketuḥ /
śrīkaṇṭhaputraiṇa raṇe hataścetprāṇapratiṣṭhaiva tadā bhavennaḥ //
3.30.d:
यो भण्डदैत्यस्य दुराशयस्य मित्रं स लोकत्रयधूमकेतुः ।
श्रीकण्ठपुत्रैण रणे हतश्चेत्प्राणप्रतिष्ठैव तदा भवेन्नः ॥
3.30.m: who was a friend of that evil-minded Daitya Bhaṇḍa and a comet of disaster to the three worlds, / will be slain; if he is killed in battle by the son of Śrīkaṇṭha, then our lives will be firmly restored.

3.30.s:
tasmāttvamaṃbatripure janānāṃ mānāpahaṃ manmathavīravaryam /
utpādyaratyā vidhavātvaduḥkhamapākuru vyākulakuntalāyāḥ //
3.30.d:
तस्मात्त्वमंबत्रिपुरे जनानां मानापहं मन्मथवीरवर्यम् ।
उत्पाद्यरत्या विधवात्वदुःखमपाकुरु व्याकुलकुन्तलायाः ॥
3.30.m: Therefore, O Mother Tripurā, create the best of heroes, Manmatha, who destroys the pride of men, / and remove the grief of widowhood from Rati whose hair is disheveled.

3.30.s:
eṣā tvanāthā bhavatīṃ prapannā bhartṛpraṇāśena kṛśāṅgayaṣṭiḥ /
namaskaroti tripurābhidhāne tadatra kāruṇyakalāṃ vidhehi //
3.30.d:
एषा त्वनाथा भवतीं प्रपन्ना भर्तृप्रणाशेन कृशाङ्गयष्टिः ।
नमस्करोति त्रिपुराभिधाने तदत्र कारुण्यकलां विधेहि ॥
3.30.m: This helpless woman has taken refuge in you, her slender body wasted by the destruction of her husband; / she bows to you, named Tripurā; therefore, bestow a fraction of your compassion here.

3.30.s:
hayagrīva uvāca
iti stutvā maheśānī brahmādyā vibudhottamāḥ /
tāṃ ratiṃ darśayamāsurmalināṃ śokakarśitam //
3.30.d:
हयग्रीव उवाच
इति स्तुत्वा महेशानी ब्रह्माद्या विबुधोत्तमाः ।
तां रतिं दर्शयमासुर्मलिनां शोककर्शितम् ॥
3.30.m:
Hayagrīva said:
Having thus praised the supreme ruler, Brahmā and the other foremost gods / showed to her that Rati, who was soiled and emaciated by grief.

3.30.s:
sā paryaśrumukhī kīrṇakuntalā dhūlidhūsarā /
nanāma jagadaṃbāṃ vai vaidhavyatyaktabhūṣaṇā //
3.30.d:
सा पर्यश्रुमुखी कीर्णकुन्तला धूलिधूसरा ।
ननाम जगदंबां वै वैधव्यत्यक्तभूषणा ॥
3.30.m: Her face filled with tears, her tresses scattered, grey with dust, / having cast off her ornaments due to widowhood, she bowed down to the Mother of the Universe.

3.30.s:
atha taddarśanotpannakāruṇyā parameśvarī /
tataḥ kaṭākṣādutpannaḥ smayamānasukhāṃbujaḥ //
3.30.d:
अथ तद्दर्शनोत्पन्नकारुण्या परमेश्वरी ।
ततः कटाक्षादुत्पन्नः स्मयमानसुखांबुजः ॥
3.30.m: Then compassion arose in the supreme Goddess at the sight of her; / and from her side-glance was born he whose lotus face was smiling,

3.30.s:
pūrvadehādhikarucirmanmatho madameduraḥ /
dvibhujaḥ sarvabhūṣāḍhyaḥ puṣpeṣuḥ puṣpakārmukaḥ //
3.30.d:
पूर्वदेहाधिकरुचिर्मन्मथो मदमेदुरः ।
द्विभुजः सर्वभूषाढ्यः पुष्पेषुः पुष्पकार्मुकः ॥
3.30.m: Manmatha, far more radiant than his former body, overflowing with pride, / two-armed, adorned with all ornaments, with flower-arrows and a flower-bow,

3.30.s:
ānandayankaṭākṣeṇa pūrvajanmapriyāṃ ratim /
atha sāpi ratirdevī mahatyānandasāgare /
majjantī nijabhartāramavarokya mudaṃ gatā //
3.30.d:
आनन्दयन्कटाक्षेण पूर्वजन्मप्रियां रतिम् ।
अथ सापि रतिर्देवी महत्यानन्दसागरे ।
मज्जन्ती निजभर्तारमवरोक्य मुदं गता ॥
3.30.m: delighting Rati, the beloved of his previous birth, with his side-glance. / Then Goddess Rati too, plunging into a vast ocean of joy / upon seeing her husband, was filled with delight.

3.30.s:
ānandayankaṭākṣeṇa pūrvajanmapriyāṃ ratim /
atha sāpi ratirdevī mahatyānandasāgare /
majjantī nijabhartāramavalokya mudaṃ gatā //
3.30.d:
आनन्दयन्कटाक्षेण पूर्वजन्मप्रियां रतिम् ।
अथ सापि रतिर्देवी महत्यानन्दसागरे ।
मज्जन्ती निजभर्तारमवलोक्य मुदं गता ॥
3.30.m: Delighting with a side-glance Rati, his beloved from his previous birth. / Then even the goddess Rati, plunging into a great ocean of joy, / reached happiness upon seeing her own husband.

3.30.s:
śyāmale snāpayitvaināṃ vastrakāñcyādibhūṣaṇaiḥ /
alaṅkṛtya yathāpūrvaṃ śīghramānīyatāmiha //
3.30.d:
श्यामले स्नापयित्वैनां वस्त्रकाञ्च्यादिभूषणैः ।
अलङ्कृत्य यथापूर्वं शीघ्रमानीयतामिह ॥
3.30.m: "O Śyāmalā, having bathed her and adorned her / with garments, girdles, and other ornaments as before, let her be brought here quickly!"

3.30.s:
tadājñāṃ śirasā dhṛtvā śyāmā sarvaṃ tathākarota /
brahmarṣibhirvasiṣṭhādyairvaivāhi kavidhānataḥ //
3.30.d:
तदाज्ञां शिरसा धृत्वा श्यामा सर्वं तथाकरोत ।
ब्रह्मर्षिभिर्वसिष्ठाद्यैर्वैवाहि कविधानतः ॥
3.30.m: Bearing her command upon her head, Śyāmā did everything accordingly. / By means of the brahmin seers led by Vasiṣṭha, according to the rites of marriage,

3.30.s:
kārayāmāsa daṃpatyoḥ pāṇigrahaṇamaṅgalam /
apsarobhiśca sarvābhirnṛtyagītādisaṃyutam //
3.30.d:
कारयामास दंपत्योः पाणिग्रहणमङ्गलम् ।
अप्सरोभिश्च सर्वाभिर्नृत्यगीतादिसंयुतम् ॥
3.30.m: She had the auspicious clasping of hands performed for the married couple, / accompanied by dancing, singing, and other festivities by all the apsarases.

3.30.s:
etaddṛṣṭvā mahendrādyā ṛṣayaśca tapodhanāḥ /
sādhusādhviti śaṃsaṃtastuṣṭuvurlalitāṃbikām //
3.30.d:
एतद्दृष्ट्वा महेन्द्राद्या ऋषयश्च तपोधनाः ।
साधुसाध्विति शंसंतस्तुष्टुवुर्ललितांबिकाम् ॥
3.30.m: Having seen this, Mahendra and the other [gods], and the seers rich in asceticism, / praising, saying "Well done! Well done!", lauded Mother Lalitā.

3.30.s:
puṣpavṛṣṭiṃ vimuñcantaḥ sarve santuṣṭamānasāḥ /
babhūvustau mahābhaktyā praṇamya laliteśvarīm //
3.30.d:
पुष्पवृष्टिं विमुञ्चन्तः सर्वे सन्तुष्टमानसाः ।
बभूवुस्तौ महाभक्त्या प्रणम्य ललितेश्वरीम् ॥
3.30.m: Releasing a shower of flowers, all their minds were satisfied. / Bowing with great devotion to Laliteśvarī, both of them

3.30.s:
tatpārśve tu samāgatya baddhāñjalipuṭau sthitau /
atha kandarpavīro 'pi namaskṛtya maheśvarīm /
vyajñāpayadidaṃ vākyaṃ bhaktinirbharamānasaḥ //
3.30.d:
तत्पार्श्वे तु समागत्य बद्धाञ्जलिपुटौ स्थितौ ।
अथ कन्दर्पवीरो ऽपि नमस्कृत्य महेश्वरीम् ।
व्यज्ञापयदिदं वाक्यं भक्तिनिर्भरमानसः ॥
3.30.m: Came to her side and stood with cupped hands folded in reverence. / Then the heroic Kandarpa also, having bowed down to Maheśvarī, / addressed this speech, his mind overflowing with devotion:

3.30.s:
yaddagdhamīśanetreṇa vapurme lalitāṃbike /
tattvadīyakaṭākṣasya prasādātpunarāgatam //
3.30.d:
यद्दग्धमीशनेत्रेण वपुर्मे ललितांबिके ।
तत्त्वदीयकटाक्षस्य प्रसादात्पुनरागतम् ॥
3.30.m: "That body of mine which was burned by the eye of the Lord, O Mother Lalitā, / has returned once more by the grace of your side-glance.

3.30.s:
tava putro 'smi dāso 'smi kvāpi kṛtye niyuṅkṣva mām /
ityuktā parameśānī tamāha makaradhvajam //
3.30.d:
तव पुत्रो ऽस्मि दासो ऽस्मि क्वापि कृत्ये नियुङ्क्ष्व माम् ।
इत्युक्ता परमेशानी तमाह मकरध्वजम् ॥
3.30.m: I am your son, I am your servant; assign me to some task!" / Thus addressed, the Supreme Sovereign spoke to that god who has the makara on his banner:

3.30.s:
śrīdevyuvāca
vatsāgaccha manojanmanna bhayaṃ tava vidyate /
matprasādājjagatsarvaṃ mohayāvyāhatāśuga //
3.30.d:
श्रीदेव्युवाच
वत्सागच्छ मनोजन्मन्न भयं तव विद्यते ।
मत्प्रसादाज्जगत्सर्वं मोहयाव्याहताशुग ॥
3.30.m: The holy Goddess said: / "Come, child born from the mind, there is no fear for you. / By my grace, enchant the entire universe, O you of unimpeded arrows!

3.30.s:
tadbāṇapātanājjātadhairyaviplava īśvaraḥ /
parvatasya sutāṃ gaurīṃ pariṇeṣyati satvaram //
3.30.d:
तद्बाणपातनाज्जातधैर्यविप्लव ईश्वरः ।
पर्वतस्य सुतां गौरीं परिणेष्यति सत्वरम् ॥
3.30.m: Through the falling of your arrows, the Lord, with his fortitude shattered, / will quickly marry Gaurī, the daughter of the mountain.

3.30.s:
sahasrakoṭayaḥ kāmā matprasādāttvadudbhavāḥ /
sarveṣāṃ dehamāviśya dāsyanti ratimuttamām //
3.30.d:
सहस्रकोटयः कामा मत्प्रसादात्त्वदुद्भवाः ।
सर्वेषां देहमाविश्य दास्यन्ति रतिमुत्तमाम् ॥
3.30.m: Ten million Kāmas, born from you by my grace, / having entered the bodies of all, will grant supreme pleasure.

3.30.s:
matprasādena vairāgyātsaṃkruddho 'pi sa īśvaraḥ /
dehadāhaṃ vidhātuṃ te na samartho bhaviṣyati //
3.30.d:
मत्प्रसादेन वैराग्यात्संक्रुद्धो ऽपि स ईश्वरः ।
देहदाहं विधातुं ते न समर्थो भविष्यति ॥
3.30.m: By my grace, even if that Lord becomes utterly enraged through dispassion, / he will not be capable of burning your body.

3.30.s:
adṛśyamūrtiḥ sarveṣāṃ prāṇināṃ bhavamohanaḥ /
svabhāryāvirahāśaṅkī dehasyārdhaṃ pradāsyati /
prayāto 'sau kātarātmā tvadbāṇāhatamānasaḥ //
3.30.d:
अदृश्यमूर्तिः सर्वेषां प्राणिनां भवमोहनः ।
स्वभार्याविरहाशङ्की देहस्यार्धं प्रदास्यति ।
प्रयातो ऽसौ कातरात्मा त्वद्बाणाहतमानसः ॥
3.30.m: Invisible in form to all living beings, enchanting the world, / anxious over separation from his wife, his mind struck by your arrows, / he will become agitated and will give up half of his body.

3.30.s:
adya prabhṛti kandarpa matprasādānmahīyasaḥ /
tvannindāṃ ye kariṣyanti tvayi vā vimukhāśayāḥ /
avaśyaṃ klībataiva syātteṣāṃ janmanijanmani //
3.30.d:
अद्य प्रभृति कन्दर्प मत्प्रसादान्महीयसः ।
त्वन्निन्दां ये करिष्यन्ति त्वयि वा विमुखाशयाः ।
अवश्यं क्लीबतैव स्यात्तेषां जन्मनिजन्मनि ॥
3.30.m: From this day forward, O Kandarpa, by my highest grace, / those who censure you, or whose minds are turned away from you, / shall inevitably become eunuchs in birth after birth.

3.30.s:
ye pāpiṣṭhā durātmāno madbhaktadrohiṇaśca hi /
tānagamyāsu nārīṣu pātayitvā vināśaya //
3.30.d:
ये पापिष्ठा दुरात्मानो मद्भक्तद्रोहिणश्च हि ।
तानगम्यासु नारीषु पातयित्वा विनाशय ॥
3.30.m: Those wicked, evil-natured people who are hostile toward my devotees— / destroy them by causing them to fall among forbidden women!

3.30.s:
yeṣāṃ madīya pūjāsu madbhakteṣvādṛtaṃ manaḥ /
teṣāṃ kāmasukhaṃ sarvaṃ saṃpādaya samīpsitam //
3.30.d:
येषां मदीय पूजासु मद्भक्तेष्वादृतं मनः ।
तेषां कामसुखं सर्वं संपादय समीप्सितम् ॥
3.30.m: Those whose minds are devoted to worship of me and toward my devotees— / bring about for them all desired pleasure of love!"

3.30.s:
iti śrīlalitādevyā kṛtājñāvacanaṃ smaraḥ /
tatheti śirasā bibhratsāṃjalirniryayau tataḥ //
3.30.d:
इति श्रीललितादेव्या कृताज्ञावचनं स्मरः ।
तथेति शिरसा बिभ्रत्सांजलिर्निर्ययौ ततः ॥
3.30.m: Thus bearing the command spoken by the holy goddess Lalitā / upon his head, saying "So be it," Smara departed with folded hands.

3.30.s:
tasyānaṅgasya sarvebhyo romakūpebhya utthitāḥ /
bahavaḥ śobhanākārā madanā viśvamohanāḥ //
3.30.d:
तस्यानङ्गस्य सर्वेभ्यो रोमकूपेभ्य उत्थिताः ।
बहवः शोभनाकारा मदना विश्वमोहनाः ॥
3.30.m: From all the hair follicles of that bodiless god arose / many Madanas of lovely form, captivating the universe.

3.30.s:
tairvimohya samastaṃ ca jagaccakraṃ manobhavaḥ /
punaḥ sthāṇvāśramaṃ prāpa candramaulerjigīṣayā //
3.30.d:
तैर्विमोह्य समस्तं च जगच्चक्रं मनोभवः ।
पुनः स्थाण्वाश्रमं प्राप चन्द्रमौलेर्जिगीषया ॥
3.30.m: Having enchanted the entire cycle of the world through them, the mind-born god / reached the hermitage of Sthāṇu once more, desiring to conquer the moon-crested god.

3.30.s:
vasaṃtena ca mitreṇa senānyā śītarociṣā /
rāgeṇa pīṭhamardena mandānilarayeṇa ca //
3.30.d:
वसंतेन च मित्रेण सेनान्या शीतरोचिषा ।
रागेण पीठमर्देन मन्दानिलरयेण च ॥
3.30.m: With Spring as his friend, with the cold-rayed moon as his army commander, / with passion as his companion, and with the swiftness of the gentle breeze,

3.30.s:
puṃskokilagalatsvānakāhalībhiśca saṃyutaḥ /
śṛṅgāravīrasaṃpanno ratyāliṅgitavigrahaḥ //
3.30.d:
पुंस्कोकिलगलत्स्वानकाहलीभिश्च संयुतः ।
शृङ्गारवीरसंपन्नो रत्यालिङ्गितविग्रहः ॥
3.30.m: And accompanied by the trumpets of the flowing cries of the male cuckoos, / endowed with erotic and heroic sentiment, his body embraced by Rati,

3.30.s:
jaitra śarāsanaṃ dhunvanpravīrāṇāṃ purogamaḥ /
madanārerabhimukhaṃ prāpya nibhaya āsthitaḥ //
3.30.d:
जैत्र शरासनं धुन्वन्प्रवीराणां पुरोगमः ।
मदनारेरभिमुखं प्राप्य निभय आस्थितः ॥
3.30.m: Brandishing his victorious bow, foremost among heroes, / arriving directly before the enemy of Madana, he stood fearlessly.

3.30.s:
taponiṣṭhaṃ candracūḍaṃ tāḍayāmāsa sāyakaiḥ /
atha kandarpabāṇaudhaistāḍitaścandraśekharaḥ /
dūrīcakāra vairāgyaṃ tapastattyāja duṣkaram //
3.30.d:
तपोनिष्ठं चन्द्रचूडं ताडयामास सायकैः ।
अथ कन्दर्पबाणौधैस्ताडितश्चन्द्रशेखरः ।
दूरीचकार वैराग्यं तपस्तत्त्याज दुष्करम् ॥
3.30.m: He struck with arrows the moon-crested god intent on asceticism. / Then Candraśekhara, struck by the streams of Kandarpa's arrows, / cast dispassion far away and abandoned that difficult asceticism.

3.30.s:
niyamānakhilāṃstyaktvā tyaktadhairyaḥ śivaḥ kṛtaḥ /
tāmeva pārvatīṃ dhyātvā bhūyobhūyaḥ smarāturaḥ //
3.30.d:
नियमानखिलांस्त्यक्त्वा त्यक्तधैर्यः शिवः कृतः ।
तामेव पार्वतीं ध्यात्वा भूयोभूयः स्मरातुरः ॥
3.30.m: Having abandoned all his vows, Śiva was made bereft of fortitude; / meditating again and again on that very Pārvatī, afflicted by love,

3.30.s:
niśaśvāsa vahañśarvaḥ pāṇḍuraṃ gaṇḍamaṇḍalam /
bāṣpāyamāṇo virahī saṃtapto dhairyaviplavāt /
bhūyobhūyo girisutāṃ pūrvadṛṣṭāmanusmaran //
3.30.d:
निशश्वास वहञ्शर्वः पाण्डुरं गण्डमण्डलम् ।
बाष्पायमाणो विरही संतप्तो धैर्यविप्लवात् ।
भूयोभूयो गिरिसुतां पूर्वदृष्टामनुस्मरन् ॥
3.30.m: Śarva sighed, bearing a pale orb of the cheek; / shedding tears, suffering separation, tormented by the ruin of his steadfastness, / remembering again and again the daughter of the mountain whom he had seen before.

3.30.s:
anaṅgabāṇadahanaistapyamānasya śūlinaḥ /
na candrarekhā no gaṅgā dehatāpacchide 'bhavat //
3.30.d:
अनङ्गबाणदहनैस्तप्यमानस्य शूलिनः ।
न चन्द्ररेखा नो गङ्गा देहतापच्छिदे ऽभवत् ॥
3.30.m: For the wielder of the trident burning with the fires of the bodiless god's arrows, / neither the crescent moon nor the Gaṅgā relieved the fever of his body.

3.30.s:
nandibhṛṅgimahākālapramukhairgaṇamaṇḍalaiḥ /
āhṛte puṣpaśayane viluloṭha muhurmuhuḥ //
3.30.d:
नन्दिभृङ्गिमहाकालप्रमुखैर्गणमण्डलैः ।
आहृते पुष्पशयने विलुलोठ मुहुर्मुहुः ॥
3.30.m: Upon the flower bed brought by the hosts of gaṇas led by Nandin, Bhṛṅgin, and Mahākāla, / he rolled over and over again.

3.30.s:
nandino hastamālaṃbya puṣpatalpāntarātpunaḥ /
puṣpatalpāntaraṃ gatvā vyaceṣṭata muhurmuhuḥ //
3.30.d:
नन्दिनो हस्तमालंब्य पुष्पतल्पान्तरात्पुनः ।
पुष्पतल्पान्तरं गत्वा व्यचेष्टत मुहुर्मुहुः ॥
3.30.m: Leaning on the hand of Nandin, going from one bed of flowers / to another bed of flowers, he tossed about again and again.

3.30.s:
na puṣpaśayanenendukhaṇḍanirgalitāmṛte /
na himānīpayasi vā nivṛttastadvapurjvaraḥ //
3.30.d:
न पुष्पशयनेनेन्दुखण्डनिर्गलितामृते ।
न हिमानीपयसि वा निवृत्तस्तद्वपुर्ज्वरः ॥
3.30.m: Neither by the flower bed, nor by nectar dripping from the crescent moon, / nor by icy water was the fever of his body allayed.

3.30.s:
sa taneratanujvālāṃ śamayiṣyanmuhurmuhuḥ /
śilībhūtānhimapayaḥ paṭṭānadhyavasacchivaḥ /
bhūyaḥ śailasutārūpaṃ citrapaṭṭe nakhairlikhat //
3.30.d:
स तनेरतनुज्वालां शमयिष्यन्मुहुर्मुहुः ।
शिलीभूतान्हिमपयः पट्टानध्यवसच्छिवः ।
भूयः शैलसुतारूपं चित्रपट्टे नखैर्लिखत् ॥
3.30.m: Wishing to extinguish the intense burning of his body again and again, / Śiva sat upon slabs of frozen snow-water; / repeatedly he drew the form of the mountain's daughter on a picture board with his nails.

3.30.s:
tadālokanato 'dūramanaṅgārtimavardhayat /
tāmālikhya hriyā namrāṃ vīkṣamāṇāṃ kaṭākṣataḥ //
3.30.d:
तदालोकनतो ऽदूरमनङ्गार्तिमवर्धयत् ।
तामालिख्य ह्रिया नम्रां वीक्षमाणां कटाक्षतः ॥
3.30.m: From the sight of that, he increased the torment of love before long; / having painted her bowed with modesty, looking with a side-glance,

3.30.s:
taccitrapaṭṭamaṅgeṣu romaharṣeṣu cākṣipat /
cintāsaṃgena mahatā mahātyā ratisaṃpadā /
bhūyasā smaratāpena vivyathe viṣamekṣaṇaḥ //
3.30.d:
तच्चित्रपट्टमङ्गेषु रोमहर्षेषु चाक्षिपत् ।
चिन्तासंगेन महता महात्या रतिसंपदा ।
भूयसा स्मरतापेन विव्यथे विषमेक्षणः ॥
3.30.m: He pressed that picture board against his limbs and his bristling hair. / Through the great association of anxieties, and the great wealth of passion, / the uneven-eyed god suffered through excessive torment of love.

3.30.s:
tāmeva sarvataḥ paśyaṃstasyāmeva mano diśan /
tathaiva saṃllapansārdhamunmādenopapannayā //
3.30.d:
तामेव सर्वतः पश्यंस्तस्यामेव मनो दिशन् ।
तथैव संल्लपन्सार्धमुन्मादेनोपपन्नया ॥
3.30.m: Seeing only her everywhere, directing his mind only toward her, / he conversed as though with her made present by his madness.

3.30.s:
tanmātrabhūtahṛdayastaccittastatparāyaṇaḥ /
tatkathāsudhayā nītasamastarajanīdinaḥ //
3.30.d:
तन्मात्रभूतहृदयस्तच्चित्तस्तत्परायणः ।
तत्कथासुधया नीतसमस्तरजनीदिनः ॥
3.30.m: His heart consisting only of her, his thoughts fixed on her, entirely devoted to her, / he passed all nights and days with the nectar of talk about her.

3.30.s:
tacchīlavarṇana ratastadrūpālokanotsukaḥ /
taccārubhogasaṃkalpamālākarasumālikaḥ /
tanmayatvamanuprāptastatāpātitarāṃ śivaḥ //
3.30.d:
तच्छीलवर्णन रतस्तद्रूपालोकनोत्सुकः ।
तच्चारुभोगसंकल्पमालाकरसुमालिकः ।
तन्मयत्वमनुप्राप्तस्ततापातितरां शिवः ॥
3.30.m: Delighting in describing her character, eager to behold her form, / a maker of garlands for the wishes of delightful union with her, / Śiva, having attained oneness with her, suffered exceedingly.

3.30.s:
imāṃ manobhava rujamacikitsyāṃ sa dhūrjaṭiḥ /
avalokya vivāhāya bhṛśamudyamavānabhūt //
3.30.d:
इमां मनोभव रुजमचिकित्स्यां स धूर्जटिः ।
अवलोक्य विवाहाय भृशमुद्यमवानभूत् ॥
3.30.m: Seeing this incurable sickness born of love, / that matted-haired god made a great effort toward marriage.

3.30.s:
itthaṃ vimohya taṃ devaṃ kandarpo lalitājñayā /
atha tāṃ parvatasutāmāśugairabhyatāpayat //
3.30.d:
इत्थं विमोह्य तं देवं कन्दर्पो ललिताज्ञया ।
अथ तां पर्वतसुतामाशुगैरभ्यतापयत् ॥
3.30.m: Having thus enchanted that god by the command of Lalitā, / Kandarpa then afflicted that daughter of the mountain with his swift arrows.

3.30.s:
prabhūtavirahajvālāmalinaiḥ śvasitānalaiḥ /
śuṣyamāṇādharadalo bhṛśaṃ pāṇḍukapolabhūḥ //
3.30.d:
प्रभूतविरहज्वालामलिनैः श्वसितानलैः ।
शुष्यमाणाधरदलो भृशं पाण्डुकपोलभूः ॥
3.30.m: With fires of sighs blackened by abundant flames of separation, / the petal of her lower lip drying up, the region of her cheeks exceedingly pale,

3.30.s:
nāhāre vā na śayane na svāpe dhṛtimicchati /
makhīsahasraiḥ siṣice nityaṃ śītopacārakaiḥ //
3.30.d:
नाहारे वा न शयने न स्वापे धृतिमिच्छति ।
मखीसहस्रैः सिषिचे नित्यं शीतोपचारकैः ॥
3.30.m: She desired no pleasure in food, nor in the bed, nor in sleep; / she was constantly sprinkled with cooling remedies by thousands of female friends.

3.30.s:
punaḥ punastapyamānā punareva ca vihvalā /
na jagāma rujāśānti manmathāgnermahīyasaḥ //
3.30.d:
पुनः पुनस्तप्यमाना पुनरेव च विह्वला ।
न जगाम रुजाशान्ति मन्मथाग्नेर्महीयसः ॥
3.30.m: Tormented again and again, and agitated again and again, / she found no alleviation of the illness from the mighty fire of Manmatha.

3.30.s:
na nidrāṃ pārvatī bheje viraheṇopatāpitā /
svatanostāpanenāsau pituḥ khedamavardhayat //
3.30.d:
न निद्रां पार्वती भेजे विरहेणोपतापिता ।
स्वतनोस्तापनेनासौ पितुः खेदमवर्धयत् ॥
3.30.m: Tormented by separation, Pārvatī found no sleep; / by the burning of her own body, she increased the grief of her father.

3.30.s:
apratīkārapuruṣaṃ virahaṃ tuhituḥ śive /
avalokya sa śailendro mahāduḥkhamavāptavān //
3.30.d:
अप्रतीकारपुरुषं विरहं तुहितुः शिवे ।
अवलोक्य स शैलेन्द्रो महादुःखमवाप्तवान् ॥
3.30.m: Seeing that the separation of his daughter from Śiva had no remedy by any man, / that lord of the mountains attained great sorrow.

3.30.s:
bhadre tvaṃ tapasā devaṃ toṣayitvā maheśvaram /
bhārtāraṃ taṃ samṛccheti pitrā sampreritātha sā //
3.30.d:
भद्रे त्वं तपसा देवं तोषयित्वा महेश्वरम् ।
भार्तारं तं समृच्छेति पित्रा सम्प्रेरिताथ सा ॥
3.30.m: "O auspicious one, having pleased the god Maheśvara through asceticism, / obtain him as your husband!" Then, thus urged by her father,

3.30.s:
himavacchailaśikhare gaurīśikharanāmani /
vakāra patilābhāya pārvatī duṣkaraṃ tapaḥ //
3.30.d:
हिमवच्छैलशिखरे गौरीशिखरनामनि ।
वकार पतिलाभाय पार्वती दुष्करं तपः ॥
3.30.m: On the peak of Mount Himavat known by the name of Gaurīśikhara, / Pārvatī undertook difficult asceticism to obtain a husband.

3.30.s:
śiśireṣu jalāvāsā grīṣme dahanamadhyagā /
arke niviṣṭadṛṣṭiśca sughoraṃ tapa āsthitā //
3.30.d:
शिशिरेषु जलावासा ग्रीष्मे दहनमध्यगा ।
अर्के निविष्टदृष्टिश्च सुघोरं तप आस्थिता ॥
3.30.m: Dwelling in water during the winters, standing amidst fires in the summer, / and fixing her gaze on the sun, she undertook most terrible asceticism.

3.30.s:
tenaiva tapasā tuṣṭaḥ sānnidhyaṃ dattavāñchivaḥ /
aṅgīcakāra tāṃ bhāryāṃ vaivāhikavidhānataḥ //
3.30.d:
तेनैव तपसा तुष्टः सान्निध्यं दत्तवाञ्छिवः ।
अङ्गीचकार तां भार्यां वैवाहिकविधानतः ॥
3.30.m: Pleased by that very asceticism, Śiva granted his presence; / he accepted her as his wife according to the marriage rites.

3.30.s:
athādripatinā dattāṃ tanayāṃ nalinekṣaṇām /
saptarṣidvārataḥ pūrvaṃ prārthitāmudavoḍha saḥ //
3.30.d:
अथाद्रिपतिना दत्तां तनयां नलिनेक्षणाम् ।
सप्तर्षिद्वारतः पूर्वं प्रार्थितामुदवोढ सः ॥
3.30.m: Then he married that lotus-eyed daughter given by the lord of mountains, / who had formerly been asked for through the Seven Sages.

3.30.s:
tayā ca ramamāṇo 'sau bahukālaṃ maheśvaraḥ /
oṣadhīprasthanagare śvaśurasya gṛhe 'vasat //
3.30.d:
तया च रममाणो ऽसौ बहुकालं महेश्वरः ।
ओषधीप्रस्थनगरे श्वशुरस्य गृहे ऽवसत् ॥
3.30.m: Sporting with her for a long time, the great lord / resided in his father-in-law's house in the city of Oṣadhīprastha.

3.30.s:
punaḥ kailāsamāgatya samastaiḥ pramathaiḥ saha /
pārvatīmānināyādrināthasya prītimāvahat //
3.30.d:
पुनः कैलासमागत्य समस्तैः प्रमथैः सह ।
पार्वतीमानिनायाद्रिनाथस्य प्रीतिमावहत् ॥
3.30.m: Returning to Kailāsa along with all his Pramathas, / he brought Pārvatī along, bringing joy to the lord of mountains.

3.30.s:
ramamāṇastayā sārthaṃ kailāse mandare tathā /
vindhyādrau hemaśaile ca malaye pāriyātrake //
3.30.d:
रममाणस्तया सार्थं कैलासे मन्दरे तथा ।
विन्ध्याद्रौ हेमशैले च मलये पारियात्रके ॥
3.30.m: Sporting with her on Kailāsa and on Mandara, / on the Vindhya mountain, on the golden mountain [Meru], on Malaya and Pāriyātra,

3.30.s:
nānāvidheṣu sthāneṣu ratiṃ prāpa maheśvaraḥ /
atha tasyāṃ sasarjograṃ vīryaṃ sā soḍhumakṣamā //
3.30.d:
नानाविधेषु स्थानेषु रतिं प्राप महेश्वरः ।
अथ तस्यां ससर्जोग्रं वीर्यं सा सोढुमक्षमा ॥
3.30.m: in various places the great lord found delight. / Then he discharged his fierce semen into her, but unable to bear it,

3.30.s:
bhuvyatyajatsāpi vahnau kṛttikāsu sa cākṣipat /
tāśca gaṅgājale 'muñcansā caiva śarakānane //
3.30.d:
भुव्यत्यजत्सापि वह्नौ कृत्तिकासु स चाक्षिपत् ।
ताश्च गङ्गाजले ऽमुञ्चन्सा चैव शरकानने ॥
3.30.m: she cast it upon the earth; the earth cast it into the fire, and he cast it into the Kṛttikās; / they released it into the waters of the Gaṅgā, and she into a forest of reeds.

3.30.s:
tatrodbhūto mahāvīro mahāsenaḥ ṣaḍānanaḥ /
gaṅgāyāścāntikaṃ nīto dhūrjaṭirvṛddhi māgamat //
3.30.d:
तत्रोद्भूतो महावीरो महासेनः षडाननः ।
गङ्गायाश्चान्तिकं नीतो धूर्जटिर्वृद्धि मागमत् ॥
3.30.m: Born there, the mighty hero, Mahāsena, the six-faced one, / was brought near to the Gaṅgā, and Dhūrjaṭi's [son] grew up.

3.30.s:
sa vardhamāno divasedivase tīvravikramaḥ /
śikṣito nijatātena sarvā vidyā avāptavān //
3.30.d:
स वर्धमानो दिवसेदिवसे तीव्रविक्रमः ।
शिक्षितो निजतातेन सर्वा विद्या अवाप्तवान् ॥
3.30.m: Growing day by day, of fierce prowess, / instructed by his own father, he mastered all sciences.

3.30.s:
atha tātakṛtānujñaḥ surasainyapatirbhavan /
tārakaṃ mārayāmāsa samastaiḥ saha dānavaiḥ //
3.30.d:
अथ तातकृतानुज्ञः सुरसैन्यपतिर्भवन् ।
तारकं मारयामास समस्तैः सह दानवैः ॥
3.30.m: Then, having received his father's permission, becoming the commander of the army of gods, / he slew Tāraka along with all the Dānavas.

3.30.s:
tatastārakadaityendravadhasantoṣaśālinā /
śakreṇa dattāṃ sa guho devasenāmupānayat //
3.30.d:
ततस्तारकदैत्येन्द्रवधसन्तोषशालिना ।
शक्रेण दत्तां स गुहो देवसेनामुपानयत् ॥
3.30.m: Then Guha married Devasenā, / who was given by Śakra, who was filled with joy at the slaying of the Daitya king Tāraka.

3.30.s:
sā śakratanayā devasenā nāma yaśasvinī /
āsādyaramaṇaṃ skandamānandaṃ mṛśamādadhau //
3.30.d:
सा शक्रतनया देवसेना नाम यशस्विनी ।
आसाद्यरमणं स्कन्दमानन्दं मृशमादधौ ॥
3.30.m: That illustrious daughter of Śakra named Devasenā, / having obtained Skanda as her husband, experienced great bliss.

3.30.s:
itthaṃ saṃmohitāśeṣaviśvacakro manobhavaḥ /
devakāryaṃ susampādya jagāma śrīpuraṃ punaḥ //
3.30.d:
इत्थं संमोहिताशेषविश्वचक्रो मनोभवः ।
देवकार्यं सुसम्पाद्य जगाम श्रीपुरं पुनः ॥
3.30.m: Thus the mind-born [Kāma], having enchanted the entire circle of the world / and duly accomplished the work of the gods, went once again to Śrīpura.

3.30.s:
yatra śrīnagare puṇye lalitā parameśvarī /
vartate jagatāmṛddhyai tatra tāṃ sevituṃ yayau //
iti śrībrahmāṇḍamahāpurāṇe uttarabhāge hayagrīvāgastyasaṃvāde lalitopākhyāne madanapunarbhavo nāma triṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
3.30.d:
यत्र श्रीनगरे पुण्ये ललिता परमेश्वरी ।
वर्तते जगतामृद्ध्यै तत्र तां सेवितुं ययौ ॥
इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डमहापुराणे उत्तरभागे हयग्रीवागस्त्यसंवादे ललितोपाख्याने मदनपुनर्भवो नाम त्रिंशो ऽध्यायः
3.30.m:
To that holy city of Śrīpura where the supreme goddess Lalitā / resides for the prosperity of the worlds, he went to worship her.

Thus ends the thirtieth chapter, named 'The Rebirth of Madana', in the Lalitopākhyāna, in the dialogue between Hayagrīva and Agastya, in the latter section of the glorious Brahmāṇḍa Mahāpurāṇa.

3.31.s:
agastya uvāca
kimidaṃ śrīpuraṃ nāma kena rūpeṇa vartate /
kena vānirmitaṃ pūrva tatsarvaṃ me nivadaya //
3.31.d:
अगस्त्य उवाच
किमिदं श्रीपुरं नाम केन रूपेण वर्तते ।
केन वानिर्मितं पूर्व तत्सर्वं मे निवदय ॥
3.31.m: Agastya said: / What is this city named Śrīpura? In what form does it exist? / By whom was it previously constructed? Tell me all of that.

3.31.s:
kiyatpramāṇaṃ kiṃ varṇaṃ kathayasva mama prabho /
tvameva sarvasandehapaṅkaśoṣaṇabhāskaraḥ //
3.31.d:
कियत्प्रमाणं किं वर्णं कथयस्व मम प्रभो ।
त्वमेव सर्वसन्देहपङ्कशोषणभास्करः ॥
3.31.m: What is its extent? What is its color? Tell me, O lord; / you alone are the sun that dries up the mud of all my doubts.

3.31.s:
hayagrīva uvāca
yathā cakrarathaṃ prāpya pūrvoktairlakṣaṇairyutam /
mahāyāgānalotpannā lalitā parameśvarī //
3.31.d:
हयग्रीव उवाच
यथा चक्ररथं प्राप्य पूर्वोक्तैर्लक्षणैर्युतम् ।
महायागानलोत्पन्ना ललिता परमेश्वरी ॥
3.31.m: Hayagrīva said: / When the supreme goddess Lalitā, born from the fire of the great sacrifice, / mounted the chariot of the cakra endowed with the characteristics previously described,

3.31.s:
kṛtvā vaivāhikīṃ līlāṃ brahmādyaiḥ prārthitā punaḥ /
vyajeṣṭa bhaṇḍanāmānamasuraṃ lokakaṇṭakam //
3.31.d:
कृत्वा वैवाहिकीं लीलां ब्रह्माद्यैः प्रार्थिता पुनः ।
व्यजेष्ट भण्डनामानमसुरं लोककण्टकम् ॥
3.31.m: having engaged in the sport of marriage and being entreated again by Brahmā and the others, / conquered the Asura named Bhaṇḍa, the thorn of the world,

3.31.s:
tadā devā mahendrādyāḥ santoṣaṃ bahu bhejire /
atha kāmeśvarasyāpi lalitāyāśca śobhanam /
nityopabhogasarvārthaṃ mandiraṃ kartumutsukāḥ //
3.31.d:
तदा देवा महेन्द्राद्याः सन्तोषं बहु भेजिरे ।
अथ कामेश्वरस्यापि ललितायाश्च शोभनम् ।
नित्योपभोगसर्वार्थं मन्दिरं कर्तुमुत्सुकाः ॥
3.31.m: then the gods, headed by Mahendra, experienced great delight. / Eager to build a splendid palace for Kāmeśvara / and for Lalitā, for all purposes of perpetual enjoyment,

3.31.s:
kumārā lalitādevyā brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ /
vardhakiṃ viśvakarmāṇaṃ surāṇāṃ śilpakovidam //
3.31.d:
कुमारा ललितादेव्या ब्रह्मविष्णुमहेश्वराः ।
वर्धकिं विश्वकर्माणं सुराणां शिल्पकोविदम् ॥
3.31.m: the sons of goddess Lalitā—Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Maheśvara—/ [called] the architect Viśvakarman, skilled in the craft of the gods,

3.31.s:
surāṇāṃ śilpanaṃ ca mayaṃ māyāvicakṣaṇam /
āhūya kṛtasatkārānūcire lalitājñayā //
3.31.d:
सुराणां शिल्पनं च मयं मायाविचक्षणम् ।
आहूय कृतसत्कारानूचिरे ललिताज्ञया ॥
3.31.m: and Maya, the craftsman of the gods and expert in illusion. / Having summoned them and rendered honor, they spoke to them by the command of Lalitā.

3.31.s:
adhikāripuruṣā ūcuḥ
bho viśvakarmañchilpajña bhobho maya mahodaya /
bhavantau sarvaśāstrajñau ghaṭanāmārgakovidau //
3.31.d:
अधिकारिपुरुषा ऊचुः
भो विश्वकर्मञ्छिल्पज्ञ भोभो मय महोदय ।
भवन्तौ सर्वशास्त्रज्ञौ घटनामार्गकोविदौ ॥
3.31.m: The sovereign beings said: / O Viśvakarman, knower of craft! O Maya of great dignity! / You two know all the treatises and are skilled in the methods of construction,

3.31.s:
saṃkalpamātreṇa mahāśilpakalpaviśāradau /
yuvābhyāṃ lalitādevyā nityajñānamahodadheḥ //
3.31.d:
संकल्पमात्रेण महाशिल्पकल्पविशारदौ ।
युवाभ्यां ललितादेव्या नित्यज्ञानमहोदधेः ॥
3.31.m: adept in great design and craftsmanship by mere intention. / By you two, for goddess Lalitā, the great ocean of eternal wisdom,

3.31.s:
ṣoḍaśīkṣetramadhyeṣu tatkṣetrasamasaṃkhyayā /
kartavyā śrīnagaryo hi nānāratnairalaṅkṛtāḥ //
3.31.d:
षोडशीक्षेत्रमध्येषु तत्क्षेत्रसमसंख्यया ।
कर्तव्या श्रीनगर्यो हि नानारत्नैरलङ्कृताः ॥
3.31.m: among the sixteen sacred sites, equal in number to those sites, / the cities of Śrīpura must be built, adorned with various jewels,

3.31.s:
yatra ṣoḍaśadhā bhinnā lalitā parameśvarī /
viśvatrāṇāya satataṃ nivāsaṃ racayiṣyati //
3.31.d:
यत्र षोडशधा भिन्ना ललिता परमेश्वरी ।
विश्वत्राणाय सततं निवासं रचयिष्यति ॥
3.31.m: where, divided sixteenfold, the supreme goddess Lalitā / will continually make her dwelling for the protection of the universe.

3.31.s:
asmākaṃ hi priyamidaṃ marutāmapica priyam /
sarvalokapriyaṃ caitattannāmnaiva viracyatām //
3.31.d:
अस्माकं हि प्रियमिदं मरुतामपिच प्रियम् ।
सर्वलोकप्रियं चैतत्तन्नाम्नैव विरच्यताम् ॥
3.31.m: For this is dear to us, and dear to the gods as well; / it is dear to all the worlds—let it be constructed under that very name.

3.31.s:
iti kāraṇadevānāṃ vacanaṃ suniśamya tau /
viśvakarmamayau natvā vyabhāṣetāṃ tathāstviti //
3.31.d:
इति कारणदेवानां वचनं सुनिशम्य तौ ।
विश्वकर्ममयौ नत्वा व्यभाषेतां तथास्त्विति ॥
3.31.m: Having heard this speech of the causal deities, both of them, / Viśvakarman and Maya, bowed down and replied, 'So be it.'

3.31.s:
punarnatvā pṛṣṭavantau tau tānkāraṇa pūruṣān /
keṣu kṣetreṣu kartavyāḥ śrīnagaryo mahodayāḥ //
3.31.d:
पुनर्नत्वा पृष्टवन्तौ तौ तान्कारण पूरुषान् ।
केषु क्षेत्रेषु कर्तव्याः श्रीनगर्यो महोदयाः ॥
3.31.m: Bowing once more, the two asked those causal persons: / In which sacred sites should the majestic cities of Śrīpura be built?

3.31.s:
brahmādyāḥ paripṛṣṭāste procustau śilpinau punaḥ /
kṣetrāṇāṃ pravibhāgaṃ tu kalpayantau yathocitam //
3.31.d:
ब्रह्माद्याः परिपृष्टास्ते प्रोचुस्तौ शिल्पिनौ पुनः ।
क्षेत्राणां प्रविभागं तु कल्पयन्तौ यथोचितम् ॥
3.31.m: Thus questioned, Brahmā and the others spoke again to the two craftsmen, / apportioning the division of the sacred sites as was appropriate.

3.31.s:
kāraṇapuruṣā ūcuḥ
prathamaṃ merupṛṣṭhe tu niṣadhe ca mahīdhare /
hemakūṭe himagirau pañcame gandhamādane //
3.31.d:
कारणपुरुषा ऊचुः
प्रथमं मेरुपृष्ठे तु निषधे च महीधरे ।
हेमकूटे हिमगिरौ पञ्चमे गन्धमादने ॥
3.31.m: The causal persons said: / First, on the back of Meru, and on the Niṣadha mountain, / on Hemakūṭa, on the Himavat mountain, and fifth on Gandhamādana,

3.31.s:
nīle meṣe ca śṛṅgāre mahendre ca mahāgirau /
kṣetrāṇi hi navaitāni bhaumāni viditānyatha //
3.31.d:
नीले मेषे च शृङ्गारे महेन्द्रे च महागिरौ ।
क्षेत्राणि हि नवैतानि भौमानि विदितान्यथ ॥
3.31.m: on Nīla, Meṣa, Śṛṅgāra, and the great mountain Mahendra; / these nine are known as the terrestrial sites.

3.31.s:
audakāni tu saptaiva proktānyakhila sindhuṣu /
lavaṇo 'bdhīkṣusārābdhiḥ surābdhirghṛtasāgaraḥ //
3.31.d:
औदकानि तु सप्तैव प्रोक्तान्यखिल सिन्धुषु ।
लवणो ऽब्धीक्षुसाराब्धिः सुराब्धिर्घृतसागरः ॥
3.31.m: The aquatic ones are declared to be seven among all the oceans: / the salt ocean, the sugarcane-juice ocean, the wine ocean, the ghee ocean,

3.31.s:
dadhisindhuḥ kṣīrasindhurjalasindhuśca saptamaḥ /
pūrvoktā nava śailendrāḥ paścātsapta ca sindhavaḥ //
3.31.d:
दधिसिन्धुः क्षीरसिन्धुर्जलसिन्धुश्च सप्तमः ।
पूर्वोक्ता नव शैलेन्द्राः पश्चात्सप्त च सिन्धवः ॥
3.31.m: the curd ocean, the milk ocean, and the fresh-water ocean as the seventh. / The previously mentioned nine lords of mountains and the seven oceans thereafter—

3.31.s:
ātdṛtya ṣoḍaśa kṣetrāṇyaṃbāśrīpurakḷptaye /
yeṣu divyāni veśmāni lalitāyā mahaujasaḥ /
sṛjataṃ divyaghaṭanāpaṇḍitau śilpinau yuvām //
3.31.d:
आत्दृत्य षोडश क्षेत्राण्यंबाश्रीपुरकॢप्तये ।
येषु दिव्यानि वेश्मानि ललिताया महौजसः ।
सृजतं दिव्यघटनापण्डितौ शिल्पिनौ युवाम् ॥
3.31.m: taking into account these sixteen sites for the construction of the Mother's Śrīpura, / in which are the divine abodes of Lalitā of great splendor, / may you two craftsmen, skilled in divine construction, create them.

3.31.s:
yeṣu kṣetreṣu kḷptāni ghnantyā devyā mahāsurān /
nāmāni nityānāmnaiva prathitāni na saṃśayaḥ //
3.31.d:
येषु क्षेत्रेषु कॢप्तानि घ्नन्त्या देव्या महासुरान् ।
नामानि नित्यानाम्नैव प्रथितानि न संशयः ॥
3.31.m: The names fashioned in those sites where the goddess slew the great Asuras / have become renowned by the very name of the Nityās, without doubt.

3.31.s:
sā hi nityāsvarūpeṇa kālavyāptikarī parā /
sarvaṃ kalayate devī kalanāṅkatayā jagat //
3.31.d:
सा हि नित्यास्वरूपेण कालव्याप्तिकरी परा ।
सर्वं कलयते देवी कलनाङ्कतया जगत् ॥
3.31.m: For in the form of the Nityā, the supreme goddess pervades time; / she holds and measures the entire universe by the marking of time.

3.31.s:
nityānāca mahārājñī nityā yatra na tadbhidā /
atastadīyanāmnā tu sanāmā prathitā purā //
3.31.d:
नित्यानाच महाराज्ञी नित्या यत्र न तद्भिदा ।
अतस्तदीयनाम्ना तु सनामा प्रथिता पुरा ॥
3.31.m: And the great queen of the Nityās is the Nityā wherein there is no differentiation; / therefore, by her name, [the cities] became renowned of old with that appellation:

3.31.s:
kāmeśvarīpurī caiva bhagamālāpurī tathā /
nityaklinnāpurītyādināmāni prathitānyalam //
3.31.d:
कामेश्वरीपुरी चैव भगमालापुरी तथा ।
नित्यक्लिन्नापुरीत्यादिनामानि प्रथितान्यलम् ॥
3.31.m: Kāmeśvarīpurī, Bhagamālāpurī, / Nityaklinnāpurī, and so forth, are the widely celebrated names.

3.31.s:
ato nāmāni varṇena yogye puṇyatame dine /
mahāśilpaprakāreṇa purīṃ racayatāṃ śubhām //
3.31.d:
अतो नामानि वर्णेन योग्ये पुण्यतमे दिने ।
महाशिल्पप्रकारेण पुरीं रचयतां शुभाम् ॥
3.31.m: Therefore, on an auspicious and most holy day, according to the color and name, / construct the auspicious city according to the method of great craftsmanship.

3.31.s:
iti kāraṇakṛtyendrairbrahmaviṣṇumaheśvaraiḥ /
proktau tau śrīpurīstheṣu teṣu kṣetreṣu cakratuḥ //
3.31.d:
इति कारणकृत्येन्द्रैर्ब्रह्मविष्णुमहेश्वरैः ।
प्रोक्तौ तौ श्रीपुरीस्थेषु तेषु क्षेत्रेषु चक्रतुः ॥
3.31.m: Thus addressed by the causal lords Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Maheśvara, / those two built [the cities] in those sites belonging to Śrīpura.

3.31.s:
atha śrīpuravistāraṃ purādhiṣṭhātṛdevatāḥ /
kathayāmyahamādhārya lopāmudrāpate śṛṇu //
3.31.d:
अथ श्रीपुरविस्तारं पुराधिष्ठातृदेवताः ।
कथयाम्यहमाधार्य लोपामुद्रापते शृणु ॥
3.31.m: Now I shall describe the extent of Śrīpura and its presiding deities / taking it as support; listen, O husband of Lopāmudrā!

3.31.s:
yo merurakhilādhārastuṅgaścānantayojanaḥ /
caturdaśajagaccakrasaṃprotanijavigrahaḥ //
3.31.d:
यो मेरुरखिलाधारस्तुङ्गश्चानन्तयोजनः ।
चतुर्दशजगच्चक्रसंप्रोतनिजविग्रहः ॥
3.31.m: That Meru which is the support of all, lofty, of endless yojanas, / whose own body is threaded through the circle of the fourteen worlds,

3.31.s:
tasya catvāri śṛṅgāṇi śakranairṛtavāyuṣu /
madhyasthaleṣu jātāni procchrāyasteṣu kathyate //
3.31.d:
तस्य चत्वारि शृङ्गाणि शक्रनैरृतवायुषु ।
मध्यस्थलेषु जातानि प्रोच्छ्रायस्तेषु कथ्यते ॥
3.31.m: has four peaks arisen in the east, south-west, north-west, / and central regions; their height is now described.

3.31.s:
pūrvoktaśṛṅgatritayaṃ śatayojanamunnatam /
śatayojanavistāraṃ teṣu lokāstrayo matāḥ //
3.31.d:
पूर्वोक्तशृङ्गत्रितयं शतयोजनमुन्नतम् ।
शतयोजनविस्तारं तेषु लोकास्त्रयो मताः ॥
3.31.m: The previously mentioned triad of peaks is one hundred yojanas high / and one hundred yojanas wide; upon them three worlds are recognized:

3.31.s:
brahmaloko viṣṇulokaḥ śivalokastathaiva ca /
eteṣāṃ gṛhavinyāsānvakṣyāmyavasarāntare //
3.31.d:
ब्रह्मलोको विष्णुलोकः शिवलोकस्तथैव च ।
एतेषां गृहविन्यासान्वक्ष्याम्यवसरान्तरे ॥
3.31.m: the world of Brahmā, the world of Viṣṇu, and likewise the world of Śiva; / the arrangement of their houses I will explain on another occasion.

3.31.s:
madhye sthitasya śṛṅgasya vistāraṃ cocchrayaṃ śṛṇu /
catuḥśataṃ yojanānāmucchritaṃ vistṛtaṃ tathā //
3.31.d:
मध्ये स्थितस्य शृङ्गस्य विस्तारं चोच्छ्रयं शृणु ।
चतुःशतं योजनानामुच्छ्रितं विस्तृतं तथा ॥
3.31.m: Hear the width and the height of the peak situated in the middle: / it is elevated four hundred yojanas, and equally extensive.

3.31.s:
tatraiva śṛṅge mahati śilpibhyāṃ śrīpuraṃ kṛtam /
catuḥśataṃ yojanānāṃ vistṛta kumbhasaṃbhava //
3.31.d:
तत्रैव शृङ्गे महति शिल्पिभ्यां श्रीपुरं कृतम् ।
चतुःशतं योजनानां विस्तृत कुम्भसंभव ॥
3.31.m: On that very great peak, the two architects constructed Śrīpura, / four hundred yojanas wide, O jar-born one.

3.31.s:
tatrāyaṃ pravibhāgaste pravivicya pradarśyate /
prākāraḥ prathamaḥ proktaḥ kālāyasavinirmitaḥ //
3.31.d:
तत्रायं प्रविभागस्ते प्रविविच्य प्रदर्श्यते ।
प्राकारः प्रथमः प्रोक्तः कालायसविनिर्मितः ॥
3.31.m: There, this division is shown to you in detailed analysis: / the first rampart is declared to be fashioned of iron.

3.31.s:
ṣaṭdaśādhikasāhasrayojanāyataveṣṭanaḥ /
caturdikṣu dvāryutaśca caturyojanamucchritaḥ //
3.31.d:
षट्दशाधिकसाहस्रयोजनायतवेष्टनः ।
चतुर्दिक्षु द्वार्युतश्च चतुर्योजनमुच्छ्रितः ॥
3.31.m: Its circumference extends sixteen thousand yojanas; / it is endowed with gates in the four directions, and is four yojanas high.

3.31.s:
śālamūlaparīṇāho yojanāyutamabdhipa /
śālāgrasya tu gavyūternaddhavātāyanaṃ pṛthak //
3.31.d:
शालमूलपरीणाहो योजनायुतमब्धिप ।
शालाग्रस्य तु गव्यूतेर्नद्धवातायनं पृथक् ॥
3.31.m: The width at the base of the rampart is ten thousand yojanas, O protector of the ocean; / moreover, individual lattice-windows are affixed on each gavyūti of the rampart's top.

3.31.s:
śāladvārasya caunnatyamekayojanamāśritam /
dvāredvāre kapāṭe dve gavyūtyardhapravistare //
3.31.d:
शालद्वारस्य चौन्नत्यमेकयोजनमाश्रितम् ।
द्वारेद्वारे कपाटे द्वे गव्यूत्यर्धप्रविस्तरे ॥
3.31.m: The height of the rampart-gate amounts to one yojana; / at every gate there are two door-leaves, half a gavyūti in width,

3.31.s:
ekayojanamunnaddhe kālāyasa vinirmite /
ubhayorargalā cetthamardhakrośasamāyatā //
3.31.d:
एकयोजनमुन्नद्धे कालायस विनिर्मिते ।
उभयोरर्गला चेत्थमर्धक्रोशसमायता ॥
3.31.m: one yojana high, and made of iron; / and for both, the bolt is likewise half a krośa in length.

3.31.s:
evaṃ caturṣu dvāreṣu sadṛśaṃ parikīrtitam /
gopurasya tu saṃsthānaṃ kathaye kuṃbhasaṃbhava //
3.31.d:
एवं चतुर्षु द्वारेषु सदृशं परिकीर्तितम् ।
गोपुरस्य तु संस्थानं कथये कुंभसंभव ॥
3.31.m: Thus it is proclaimed to be identical across the four gates. / But now I shall explain the arrangement of the gate-tower, O jar-born one.

3.31.s:
pūrvoktasya tu śālasya mūle yojanasaṃmite /
pārśvadvaye yojane dve dve samādāya nirmite //
3.31.d:
पूर्वोक्तस्य तु शालस्य मूले योजनसंमिते ।
पार्श्वद्वये योजने द्वे द्वे समादाय निर्मिते ॥
3.31.m: At the base of the aforesaid rampart measuring one yojana, / two yojanas are taken on each of the two flanks and constructed,

3.31.s:
vistāramapi tāvantaṃ saṃprāptaṃ dvāragarbhitam /
pārśvadvayaṃ yojane dve madhye śālasya yojanam //
3.31.d:
विस्तारमपि तावन्तं संप्राप्तं द्वारगर्भितम् ।
पार्श्वद्वयं योजने द्वे मध्ये शालस्य योजनम् ॥
3.31.m: reaching an equal width, containing the gate: / two yojanas on both flanks, and one yojana for the rampart in the middle.

3.31.s:
melayitvā pañca mune yojanāni pramāṇataḥ /
pārśvadvayena sārdhena krośayugmena saṃyutam //
3.31.d:
मेलयित्वा पञ्च मुने योजनानि प्रमाणतः ।
पार्श्वद्वयेन सार्धेन क्रोशयुग्मेन संयुतम् ॥
3.31.m: Putting them together, O sage, it measures five yojanas; / along with both flanks, it is joined with a pair of krośas and a half.

3.31.s:
melayitvā pañcasaṃkhyāyojanānyāyatastathā /
evaṃ prākāratastatra gopuraṃ racitaṃ mune //
3.31.d:
मेलयित्वा पञ्चसंख्यायोजनान्यायतस्तथा ।
एवं प्राकारतस्तत्र गोपुरं रचितं मुने ॥
3.31.m: Combining [these], its length is likewise five yojanas in number; / thus the gate-tower was constructed there from the rampart, O sage.

3.31.s:
tasmādgopuramūlasya veṣṭo viṃśatiyojanaḥ /
uparyupari veṣṭasya hrāsa eva prakīrtyate //
3.31.d:
तस्माद्गोपुरमूलस्य वेष्टो विंशतियोजनः ।
उपर्युपरि वेष्टस्य ह्रास एव प्रकीर्त्यते ॥
3.31.m: Therefore the circumference at the base of the gate-tower is twenty yojanas; / a diminishing of the circumference higher and higher up is proclaimed.

3.31.s:
gopurasyonnatiḥ proktāpañcaviṃśatiyojanā /
yojaneyojane dvāraṃ sakapāṭaṃ manoharam //
3.31.d:
गोपुरस्योन्नतिः प्रोक्तापञ्चविंशतियोजना ।
योजनेयोजने द्वारं सकपाटं मनोहरम् ॥
3.31.m: The height of the gate-tower is declared to be twenty-five yojanas; / at every yojana there is an enchanting gate with leaves.

3.31.s:
bhūmikāścāpi tāvantyo yathordhvaṃ hrāsasaṃyutāḥ /
gopurāgrasya nistāro yojanaṃ hi samāśritaḥ //
3.31.d:
भूमिकाश्चापि तावन्त्यो यथोर्ध्वं ह्राससंयुताः ।
गोपुराग्रस्य निस्तारो योजनं हि समाश्रितः ॥
3.31.m: And there are as many storeys, diminishing upward in order; / the breadth at the top of the gate-tower indeed amounts to a yojana,

3.31.s:
āyāmo 'pi ca tāvānvai tatra trimukuṭaṃ smṛtam /
mukuṭasya tu vistāraḥ krośamāno ghaṭodbhava //
3.31.d:
आयामो ऽपि च तावान्वै तत्र त्रिमुकुटं स्मृतम् ।
मुकुटस्य तु विस्तारः क्रोशमानो घटोद्भव ॥
3.31.m: and its length is also of that extent; three pinnacles are traditionally remembered there. / But the width of a pinnacle measures a krośa, O jar-born one;

3.31.s:
krośadvayaṃ samunnaddhaṃ hrāsaṃ gopuravanmune /
mukuṭasyāntare kṣoṇī krośārdhena ca saṃmitā //
3.31.d:
क्रोशद्वयं समुन्नद्धं ह्रासं गोपुरवन्मुने ।
मुकुटस्यान्तरे क्षोणी क्रोशार्धेन च संमिता ॥
3.31.m: it rises two krośas high, tapering like the gate-tower, O sage. / The ground between the pinnacles measures half a krośa.

3.31.s:
mukuṭaṃ paścime prācyāṃ dakṣiṇe dvāragopure /
dakṣottarastu mukuṭāḥ paścimadvāragopure //
3.31.d:
मुकुटं पश्चिमे प्राच्यां दक्षिणे द्वारगोपुरे ।
दक्षोत्तरस्तु मुकुटाः पश्चिमद्वारगोपुरे ॥
3.31.m: There is a pinnacle on the west and on the east of the southern gate-tower; / but the pinnacles on the western gate-tower are on the south and north.

3.31.s:
dakṣiṇadvāravatproktā uttaradvāḥkirīṭikāḥ /
paścimadvāravatpūrvadvāre mukuṭakalpanā //
3.31.d:
दक्षिणद्वारवत्प्रोक्ता उत्तरद्वाःकिरीटिकाः ।
पश्चिमद्वारवत्पूर्वद्वारे मुकुटकल्पना ॥
3.31.m: The crests of the northern gate are declared to be like those of the southern gate; / the arrangement of pinnacles on the eastern gate is like that of the western gate.

3.31.s:
kālāyasākhyaśālasyāntare mārutayojane /
antare kāṃsyaśālasya pūrvavadgopuro 'nvitaḥ //
3.31.d:
कालायसाख्यशालस्यान्तरे मारुतयोजने ।
अन्तरे कांस्यशालस्य पूर्ववद्गोपुरो ऽन्वितः ॥
3.31.m: Within the rampart named Iron, at a distance of forty-nine yojanas, / inside is the bronze rampart, furnished with gate-towers as before.

3.31.s:
śālamūlapramāṇaṃ ca pūrvavatparikīrtitam /
kāṃsyaśālo 'pi pūrvādidikṣu dvārasamanvintaḥ //
3.31.d:
शालमूलप्रमाणं च पूर्ववत्परिकीर्तितम् ।
कांस्यशालो ऽपि पूर्वादिदिक्षु द्वारसमन्विन्तः ॥
3.31.m: The dimension of the base of the rampart is declared to be as before; / the bronze rampart also is furnished with gates in the east and other directions.

3.31.s:
dvāredvāre gopurāṇi parvalakṣaṇabhāñji ca /
kālāyasasya kāṃsyasya yoṃ'tardeśaḥ samantataḥ //
3.31.d:
द्वारेद्वारे गोपुराणि पर्वलक्षणभाञ्जि च ।
कालायसस्य कांस्यस्य योंऽतर्देशः समन्ततः ॥
3.31.m: At every gate there are gate-towers possessing the characteristics of the nodes. / The intermediate space all around between the iron [rampart] and the bronze [rampart]

3.31.s:
nānāvṛkṣamahodyānaṃ tatproktaṃ kumbhasaṃbhava /
udbhijjādyaṃ yāvadasti tatsarvaṃ tatra vartate //
3.31.d:
नानावृक्षमहोद्यानं तत्प्रोक्तं कुम्भसंभव ।
उद्भिज्जाद्यं यावदस्ति तत्सर्वं तत्र वर्तते ॥
3.31.m: is declared to be a great orchard of various trees, O jar-born one; / whatever plants and vegetation exist, all of that is present there.

3.31.s:
paraṃsahasrāstaravaḥ sadāpuṣpāḥ sadāphalāḥ /
sadāpallavaśobhāḍhyāḥ sadā saurabhasaṃkulāḥ //
3.31.d:
परंसहस्रास्तरवः सदापुष्पाः सदाफलाः ।
सदापल्लवशोभाढ्याः सदा सौरभसंकुलाः ॥
3.31.m: There are more than a thousand trees, ever flowering, ever fruiting, / ever rich in the beauty of sprouts, and ever dense with fragrance:

3.31.s:
cūtāḥ kaṅkolakā lodhrā bakulāḥ karṇikārakāḥ /
śiṃśapāśca śirīṣāśca devadārunameravaḥ //
3.31.d:
चूताः कङ्कोलका लोध्रा बकुलाः कर्णिकारकाः ।
शिंशपाश्च शिरीषाश्च देवदारुनमेरवः ॥
3.31.m: cūtas, kaṅkolakas, lodhras, bakulas, karṇikārakas, / śiṃśapās, śirīṣas, and devadāru and nameru trees,

3.31.s:
punnāgā nāgabhadrāśca mucukundāśca kaṭphalāḥ /
elālavaṅgāstakkolāstathā karpūraśākhinaḥ //
3.31.d:
पुन्नागा नागभद्राश्च मुचुकुन्दाश्च कट्फलाः ।
एलालवङ्गास्तक्कोलास्तथा कर्पूरशाखिनः ॥
3.31.m: punnāgas, nāgabhadras, mucukundas, kaṭphalas, / cardamoms, cloves, takkolas, and camphor trees,

3.31.s:
pīlavaḥ kākatuṇḍyaśca śālakāścāsanāstathā /
kāñcanārāśca lakucāḥ panasā hiṅgulāstathā //
3.31.d:
पीलवः काकतुण्ड्यश्च शालकाश्चासनास्तथा ।
काञ्चनाराश्च लकुचाः पनसा हिङ्गुलास्तथा ॥
3.31.m: pīlus, kākatuṇḍīs, śālakas, asanas, / kāñcanāras, lakucas, jackfruits, and hiṅgulas,

3.31.s:
pāṭalāśca phalinyaśca jaṭilyo jaghanephalāḥ /
gaṇikāśca kuraṇṭāśca bandhujīvāśca dāḍimāḥ //
3.31.d:
पाटलाश्च फलिन्यश्च जटिल्यो जघनेफलाः ।
गणिकाश्च कुरण्टाश्च बन्धुजीवाश्च दाडिमाः ॥
3.31.m: pāṭalās, phalins, jaṭilīs, jaghanephalās, / gaṇikās, kuraṇṭas, bandhujīvas, and pomegranates,

3.31.s:
aśvakarṇā hastikarṇāścāṃpeyāḥ kanakadrumāḥ /
yūthikāstālaparṇyaśca tulasyaśca sadāphalāḥ //
3.31.d:
अश्वकर्णा हस्तिकर्णाश्चांपेयाः कनकद्रुमाः ।
यूथिकास्तालपर्ण्यश्च तुलस्यश्च सदाफलाः ॥
3.31.m: aśvakarṇas, hastikarṇas, campakas, golden trees, / yūthikās, tālaparṇīs, and ever-fruitful tulasīs,

3.31.s:
tālāstamālahintālakharjūrāḥ śarabarburāḥ /
ikṣavaḥ kṣīriṇaścaiva śleṣmāntakavibhītakāḥ //
3.31.d:
तालास्तमालहिन्तालखर्जूराः शरबर्बुराः ।
इक्षवः क्षीरिणश्चैव श्लेष्मान्तकविभीतकाः ॥
3.31.m: palmyras, tamālas, hintālas, date palms, reeds, babbūlas, / sugarcanes, milky trees, śleṣmāntakas, and vibhītakas,

3.31.s:
harītkyastvavākpuṣpyo ghoṇṭālyaḥ svargapuṣpikāḥ /
bhallātakāśca khadirāḥ śākhoṭāścandanadrumāḥ //
3.31.d:
हरीत्क्यस्त्ववाक्पुष्प्यो घोण्टाल्यः स्वर्गपुष्पिकाः ।
भल्लातकाश्च खदिराः शाखोटाश्चन्दनद्रुमाः ॥
3.31.m: harītakīs, avākpuṣpīs, ghoṇṭālīs, svargapuṣpikās, / bhallātakas, khadiras, śākhoṭas, and sandalwood trees,

3.31.s:
kālāgurudrumāḥ kālaskandhāściñcā vadāstathā /
uduṃbarārjunāśvatthāḥ śamīvṛkṣā dhruvādrumāḥ //
3.31.d:
कालागुरुद्रुमाः कालस्कन्धाश्चिञ्चा वदास्तथा ।
उदुंबरार्जुनाश्वत्थाः शमीवृक्षा ध्रुवाद्रुमाः ॥
3.31.m: black aloe trees, kālaskandhas, tamarinds, banyans, / udumbaras, arjunas, aśvatthas, śamī trees, dhruvā trees,

3.31.s:
rucakāḥ kuṭajāḥ saptaparṇāśca kṛtamālakāḥ /
kapitthāstintiṇī caivetyevamādhyāḥ sahasraśaḥ //
3.31.d:
रुचकाः कुटजाः सप्तपर्णाश्च कृतमालकाः ।
कपित्थास्तिन्तिणी चैवेत्येवमाध्याः सहस्रशः ॥
3.31.m: rucakas, kuṭajas, saptaparṇas, kṛtamālakas, / kapitthas, and wood-apples, and thus thousands of such [trees],

3.31.s:
nānāṛtusamāviṣṭā devyāḥ śṛṅgārahetavaḥ /
nānāvṛkṣamahotsedhā vartante varaśākhinaḥ //
3.31.d:
नानाऋतुसमाविष्टा देव्याः शृङ्गारहेतवः ।
नानावृक्षमहोत्सेधा वर्तन्ते वरशाखिनः ॥
3.31.m: pervaded by the various seasons, the causes of the Goddess's love sports; / great trees of various sorts stand as excellent branches.

3.31.s:
kāṃsyaśālasyāntarole saptayojanadūrataḥ /
caturasrastāmraśālaḥ siṃdhuyojanamunnataḥ //
3.31.d:
कांस्यशालस्यान्तरोले सप्तयोजनदूरतः ।
चतुरस्रस्ताम्रशालः सिंधुयोजनमुन्नतः ॥
3.31.m: In the interior of the bronze rampart, at a distance of seven yojanas, / stands the square copper rampart, four yojanas high.

3.31.s:
anayorantarakṣoṇī proktā kalpakavāṭikā /
karpūragandhibhiścāruratnabījasamanvitaiḥ //
3.31.d:
अनयोरन्तरक्षोणी प्रोक्ता कल्पकवाटिका ।
कर्पूरगन्धिभिश्चारुरत्नबीजसमन्वितैः ॥
3.31.m: The intermediate ground between the two is proclaimed as the Kalpaka Garden; / the trees are bearing fruit with camphor-scented fruits,

3.31.s:
kāñcanatvaksuruciraiḥ phalaistaiḥ phalitā drumāḥ /
pītāṃbarāṇi divyāni pravālānyeva śākhiṣu //
3.31.d:
काञ्चनत्वक्सुरुचिरैः फलैस्तैः फलिता द्रुमाः ।
पीतांबराणि दिव्यानि प्रवालान्येव शाखिषु ॥
3.31.m: endowed with lovely gem-like seeds and pleasing golden bark; / the sprouts on the trees are heavenly yellow garments.

3.31.s:
amṛtaṃ syānmadhurasaḥ puṣpāṇi ca vibhūṣaṇam /
īdṛśā vahavastatra kalpavṛkṣāḥ prakīrtitāḥ //
3.31.d:
अमृतं स्यान्मधुरसः पुष्पाणि च विभूषणम् ।
ईदृशा वहवस्तत्र कल्पवृक्षाः प्रकीर्तिताः ॥
3.31.m: Their sweet nectar-juice is ambrosia, and their flowers are ornaments; / many wish-granting trees of this kind are celebrated there.

3.31.s:
eṣā kakṣā dvitīyā syānkalpavāpīti nāmataḥ /
tāmraśālasyāntarāle nāgaśālaḥ prakīrtitāḥ //
3.31.d:
एषा कक्षा द्वितीया स्यान्कल्पवापीति नामतः ।
ताम्रशालस्यान्तराले नागशालः प्रकीर्तिताः ॥
3.31.m: This is the second enclosure, known by the name of Kalpavāpī. / In the interior of the copper rampart, the lead rampart is proclaimed.

3.31.s:
anayorubhayostiryagadeśaḥ syātsaptayojanaḥ /
tatra saṃtānavāṭī syānkalpavāpīsamākṛtiḥ //
3.31.d:
अनयोरुभयोस्तिर्यगदेशः स्यात्सप्तयोजनः ।
तत्र संतानवाटी स्यान्कल्पवापीसमाकृतिः ॥
3.31.m: The transverse space between these two is seven yojanas; / there is the Saṃtāna Garden, similar in form to the Kalpavāpī.

3.31.s:
tayormadhye mahī proktā haricandanavāṭikā /
kalpavāṭīsamākārā phalapuṣpasamākulā //
3.31.d:
तयोर्मध्ये मही प्रोक्ता हरिचन्दनवाटिका ।
कल्पवाटीसमाकारा फलपुष्पसमाकुला ॥
3.31.m: Between the two, the ground is declared to be the Haricandana Garden, / similar in form to the Kalpa Garden, dense with fruits and flowers.

3.31.s:
eṣu sarveṣu śāleṣu pūrvavaddvārakalpanam /
pūrvavadgopurāṇāṃ ca mukuṭānāṃ ca kalpanam //
3.31.d:
एषु सर्वेषु शालेषु पूर्ववद्द्वारकल्पनम् ।
पूर्ववद्गोपुराणां च मुकुटानां च कल्पनम् ॥
3.31.m: In all these ramparts, the arrangement of gates is as before, / and the arrangement of gate-towers and pinnacles is as before,

3.31.s:
gopuradvārakḷptaṃ ca dvāre dvāre ca saṃmitiḥ /
ārakūṭasyāntarāle saptayojanadūrataḥ //
3.31.d:
गोपुरद्वारकॢप्तं च द्वारे द्वारे च संमितिः ।
आरकूटस्यान्तराले सप्तयोजनदूरतः ॥
3.31.m: along with the gate-tower design and dimensions at every gate. / In the interior of the brass [rampart], at a distance of seven yojanas,

3.31.s:
pañcalohamayaḥ śālaḥ pūrvaśālasamākṛtiḥ /
tayormadhye mahī proktā mandāradrumavāṭikā //
3.31.d:
पञ्चलोहमयः शालः पूर्वशालसमाकृतिः ।
तयोर्मध्ये मही प्रोक्ता मन्दारद्रुमवाटिका ॥
3.31.m: is the rampart made of the five metals, similar in appearance to the previous rampart; / between the two, the ground is proclaimed as the Mandāra-tree Garden.

3.31.s:
pañcalohasyāntarāle saptayojanadūrataḥ /
raupyaśālastu saṃproktaḥ pūrvoktairlakṣaṇairyutaḥ //
3.31.d:
पञ्चलोहस्यान्तराले सप्तयोजनदूरतः ।
रौप्यशालस्तु संप्रोक्तः पूर्वोक्तैर्लक्षणैर्युतः ॥
3.31.m: In the interior of the five-metal [rampart], at a distance of seven yojanas, / the silver rampart is proclaimed, endowed with the aforesaid characteristics;

3.31.s:
tayormadhyamahī proktā pārijātadruvāṭikā /
divyāmodasusaṃpūrṇā phalapuṣpabharojjvalā //
3.31.d:
तयोर्मध्यमही प्रोक्ता पारिजातद्रुवाटिका ।
दिव्यामोदसुसंपूर्णा फलपुष्पभरोज्ज्वला ॥
3.31.m: between the two, the ground is proclaimed as the Pārijāta-tree Garden, / filled with divine fragrance, radiant with an abundance of fruits and flowers.

3.31.s:
raupyaśālasyāntarāle saptayojanavistaraḥ /
hemaśālaḥ prakathitaḥ pūrvavaddvāraśobhitaḥ //
3.31.d:
रौप्यशालस्यान्तराले सप्तयोजनविस्तरः ।
हेमशालः प्रकथितः पूर्ववद्द्वारशोभितः ॥
3.31.m: In the interior of the silver rampart, seven yojanas in width, / the gold rampart is celebrated, adorned with gates as before;

3.31.s:
tayormadhye mahīproktā kadambataruvāṭikā /
tatra divyā nīpavṛkṣā yojanadvayamunnatāḥ //
3.31.d:
तयोर्मध्ये महीप्रोक्ता कदम्बतरुवाटिका ।
तत्र दिव्या नीपवृक्षा योजनद्वयमुन्नताः ॥
3.31.m: between the two, the ground is proclaimed as the Kadamba-tree Garden. / There, divine nīpa trees rise two yojanas high,

3.31.s:
sadaiva madirāspandā meduraprasavojjvalāḥ /
yebhyaḥ kādaṃbarī nāma yoginī bhogadāyinī //
3.31.d:
सदैव मदिरास्पन्दा मेदुरप्रसवोज्ज्वलाः ।
येभ्यः कादंबरी नाम योगिनी भोगदायिनी ॥
3.31.m: always exuding intoxicating liquor, radiant with dense blossoms, / from which [emanates] the Yoginī named Kādambarī, bestower of enjoyment.

3.31.s:
viśiṣṭā madirodyānā mantriṇyāḥ satataṃ priyā /
te nīpavṛkṣāḥ succhāyāḥ patralāḥ pallavākulāḥ /
āmodalolabhṛṅgālījhaṅkāraiḥ pūritodarāḥ //
3.31.d:
विशिष्टा मदिरोद्याना मन्त्रिण्याः सततं प्रिया ।
ते नीपवृक्षाः सुच्छायाः पत्रलाः पल्लवाकुलाः ।
आमोदलोलभृङ्गालीझङ्कारैः पूरितोदराः ॥
3.31.m:
Distinguished, possessing an orchard of intoxicating drink, ever dear to the Mantriṇī,
those kadamba trees are beautifully shaded, leafy, and laden with fresh sprouts,
their hollows filled with the humming swarms of bees restless with fragrance.

3.31.s:
tatraiva mantriṇīnāthāyā mandiraṃ sumanoharam /
kadaṃbavanavāṭyāstu vidikṣujvalanāditaḥ //
3.31.d:
तत्रैव मन्त्रिणीनाथाया मन्दिरं सुमनोहरम् ।
कदंबवनवाट्यास्तु विदिक्षुज्वलनादितः ॥
3.31.m:
Right there stands the delightful palace of the mistress Mantriṇī.
In the intermediate directions of the kadamba grove, beginning with the southeast (the direction of Agni),

3.31.s:
catvāri mandirāṇyuccaiḥ kalpitānyādiśilpinā /
ekaikasya tu ge7sya vistāraḥ pañcayojanaḥ //
3.31.d:
चत्वारि मन्दिराण्युच्चैः कल्पितान्यादिशिल्पिना ।
एकैकस्य तु गे7स्य विस्तारः पञ्चयोजनः ॥
3.31.m:
four lofty palaces were fashioned by the primordial craftsman [Maya].
The breadth of each individual mansion is five yojanas,

3.31.s:
pañcayojanamāyāmaḥ saptāvaraṇataḥ sthitiḥ /
evamanyavidikṣu syussarvatra priyakadrumāḥ /
nivāsanagarī seyaṃ śyāmāyāḥ parikīrtitā //
3.31.d:
पञ्चयोजनमायामः सप्तावरणतः स्थितिः ।
एवमन्यविदिक्षु स्युस्सर्वत्र प्रियकद्रुमाः ।
निवासनगरी सेयं श्यामायाः परिकीर्तिता ॥

3.31.s:
senārthaṃ nagarī tvanyā mahāpadmāṭavīsthale /
yadatraiva gṛha tasyā bahuyojanadūrataḥ //
3.31.d:
सेनार्थं नगरी त्वन्या महापद्माटवीस्थले ।
यदत्रैव गृह तस्या बहुयोजनदूरतः ॥
3.31.m:
There is another city for the army in the region of the great lotus grove,
since her dwelling here is separated from it by many yojanas.

3.31.s:
śrīdevyā nityasevā tu matriṇyā na ghaṭiṣyate /
ataścitāmaṇigṛhopānte 'pi bhavanaṃ kṛtam /
tasyāḥ śrīmantranāthāyāḥ suratvaṣṭrā mayena ca //
3.31.d:
श्रीदेव्या नित्यसेवा तु मत्रिण्या न घटिष्यते ।
अतश्चितामणिगृहोपान्ते ऽपि भवनं कृतम् ।
तस्याः श्रीमन्त्रनाथायाः सुरत्वष्ट्रा मयेन च ॥

3.31.s:
śrīpure mantreṇī devyā mandirasya guṇānbahun /
varṇayiṣyati ko nāma yo dvijihvāsahasravān //
3.31.d:
श्रीपुरे मन्त्रेणी देव्या मन्दिरस्य गुणान्बहुन् ।
वर्णयिष्यति को नाम यो द्विजिह्वासहस्रवान् ॥
3.31.m:
Who indeed could describe the many excellent qualities of the palace of the Mantriṇī Devī in Śrīpura,
[even] one who possesses a thousand split tongues?

3.31.s:
kādaṃbarīmadātāmranayanāḥ kalavīṇayā /
gāyantyastatra khelanti mānyamātaṅgakanyakāḥ //
3.31.d:
कादंबरीमदाताम्रनयनाः कलवीणया ।
गायन्त्यस्तत्र खेलन्ति मान्यमातङ्गकन्यकाः ॥
3.31.m:
With eyes slightly reddened from intoxicating kādambarī wine,
singing to the melodious vīṇā, the venerable daughters of Mātaṅga play there.

3.31.s:
agastya uvāca
mātaṅgo nāma kaḥproktastasya kanyāḥ kathaṃ ca tāḥ /
sevante mantriṇīnāthāṃ sadā madhumadālasāḥ //
3.31.d:
अगस्त्य उवाच
मातङ्गो नाम कःप्रोक्तस्तस्य कन्याः कथं च ताः ।
सेवन्ते मन्त्रिणीनाथां सदा मधुमदालसाः ॥
3.31.m:
Agastya said:
Who is the one named Mātaṅga, and how do those daughters of his
serve the mistress Mantriṇī, ever languid with the intoxication of wine?

3.31.s:
hayagrīva uvāca
mataṅgo nāma tapasāmekarāśistapodhanaḥ /
mahāprabhāvasaṃpanno jagatsarjanalaṃpaṭaḥ //
3.31.d:
हयग्रीव उवाच
मतङ्गो नाम तपसामेकराशिस्तपोधनः ।
महाप्रभावसंपन्नो जगत्सर्जनलंपटः ॥
3.31.m:
Hayagrīva said:
Mataṅga was an ascetic, an unequalled mass of austerities,
endowed with great majesty, eager to create a universe,

3.31.s:
tapaḥ śaktyāttadhiyā ca sarvatrājñāpravarttakaḥ /
tasya putrastu mātaṅgo mudriṇīṃ mantrināyikām //
3.31.d:
तपः शक्त्यात्तधिया च सर्वत्राज्ञाप्रवर्त्तकः ।
तस्य पुत्रस्तु मातङ्गो मुद्रिणीं मन्त्रिनायिकाम् ॥
3.31.m:
and by the power of his austerity and his acquired wisdom, he enforced his command everywhere.
His son was Mātaṅga, who, with firm intellect,

3.31.s:
.
ghoraistapobhiratyarthaṃ pūrayāmāsa dhīradhīḥ /
mataṅgamuniputreṇa suciraṃ samupāsitā //
3.31.d:
.
घोरैस्तपोभिरत्यर्थं पूरयामास धीरधीः ।
मतङ्गमुनिपुत्रेण सुचिरं समुपासिता ॥
3.31.m:
.
With terrible austerities, he of steady mind completely fulfilled [it],
worshiped for a long time by the son of the sage Mataṅga.

3.31.s:
mantriṇī kṛtasānnidhyā vṛṇīṣva varamityaśāt /
so 'pisarvamuniśreṣṭho mātaṅgastapasāṃ nidhiḥ /
uvāca tāṃ puro dattasānnidhyāṃ śyāmalāṃbikām //
3.31.d:
मन्त्रिणी कृतसान्निध्या वृणीष्व वरमित्यशात् ।
सो ऽपिसर्वमुनिश्रेष्ठो मातङ्गस्तपसां निधिः ।
उवाच तां पुरो दत्तसान्निध्यां श्यामलांबिकाम् ॥
3.31.m:
the Mantriṇī, making herself manifest, commanded: ‘Choose a boon!’
And he too, the foremost among all sages, Mātaṅga, a treasure of austerities,
spoke to that mother Śyāmalā who had granted her presence before him.

3.31.s:
mātaṅgamahāmuniruvāca
devī tvatsmṛtimātreṇa sarvāśca mama siddhayaḥ /
jātā evāṇimādyāstāḥ sarvāścānyā vibhūtayaḥ //
3.31.d:
मातङ्गमहामुनिरुवाच
देवी त्वत्स्मृतिमात्रेण सर्वाश्च मम सिद्धयः ।
जाता एवाणिमाद्यास्ताः सर्वाश्चान्या विभूतयः ॥
3.31.m:
The great sage Mātaṅga said:
O Devī, merely by remembering you, all my supernatural attainments—
those beginning with animan—have indeed arisen, as well as all other riches.

3.31.s:
prāpaṇīyanna me kiñcidastyaṃbabhuvanatraye /
sarvataḥ prāptakālasya bhavatyāścaritasmṛteḥ //
3.31.d:
प्रापणीयन्न मे किञ्चिदस्त्यंबभुवनत्रये ।
सर्वतः प्राप्तकालस्य भवत्याश्चरितस्मृतेः ॥
3.31.m:
There is nothing in the three worlds for me to obtain, O Mother,
since all desires have been attained by remembering your deeds.

3.31.s:
athāpi tava sāṃnidhyamidaṃ no niṣphalaṃ bhavet /
evaṃ paraṃ prārthaye 'haṃ taṃ varaṃ pūrayāṃbike //
3.31.d:
अथापि तव सांनिध्यमिदं नो निष्फलं भवेत् ।
एवं परं प्रार्थये ऽहं तं वरं पूरयांबिके ॥
3.31.m:
Nevertheless, this presence of yours must not be in vain.
This alone I ask, O Mother; fulfill that boon!

3.31.s:
pūrvaṃ himavatā sārthaṃ sauhārdaṃ parihāsavān /
krīḍāmattena cāvācyaistatra tena pragalbhitam //
3.31.d:
पूर्वं हिमवता सार्थं सौहार्दं परिहासवान् ।
क्रीडामत्तेन चावाच्यैस्तत्र तेन प्रगल्भितम् ॥
3.31.m:
Formerly, having friendship and teasing jest with Himavat,
he, intoxicated with sporting, spoke insolently there with words that ought not to be said:

3.31.s:
ahaṅgaurīgururiti ślāghāmātmani tenivān /
tadvākyaṃ mama naivābhūdyatastatrādhiko guṇaḥ //
3.31.d:
अहङ्गौरीगुरुरिति श्लाघामात्मनि तेनिवान् ।
तद्वाक्यं मम नैवाभूद्यतस्तत्राधिको गुणः ॥
3.31.m:
He boasted in himself, saying, ‘I am the father of Gaurī!’
No such statement was possible for me, because he possessed greater excellence in that regard.

3.31.s:
ubhayorguṇasāmye tu mitrayoradhike guṇe /
ekasya kāraṇājjāte tatrānyasya spṛhā bhavet //
3.31.d:
उभयोर्गुणसाम्ये तु मित्रयोरधिके गुणे ।
एकस्य कारणाज्जाते तत्रान्यस्य स्पृहा भवेत् ॥
3.31.m:
Between two friends of equal merit, when a superior quality
arises in one due to some cause, desire for that arises in the other.

3.31.s:
gaurīgurutvaślāghārthaṃ prāptakāmo 'pyahaṃ tapaḥ /
kṛtavānmantriṇīnāthe tattvaṃmattanayā bhava //
3.31.d:
गौरीगुरुत्वश्लाघार्थं प्राप्तकामो ऽप्यहं तपः ।
कृतवान्मन्त्रिणीनाथे तत्त्वंमत्तनया भव ॥
3.31.m:
For the sake of the glory of being the father of Gaurī, though all my desires were attained,
I performed austerity, O mistress Mantriṇī: therefore, become my daughter!

3.31.s:
yato mannāmavikhyātā bhaviṣyasi na saṃśayaḥ /
ityuktaṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā mātaṅgasya mahāmuneḥ /
tathāstviti tiroghat sa ca prīto 'bhavanmuniḥ //
3.31.d:
यतो मन्नामविख्याता भविष्यसि न संशयः ।
इत्युक्तं वचनं श्रुत्वा मातङ्गस्य महामुनेः ।
तथास्त्विति तिरोघत् स च प्रीतो ऽभवन्मुनिः ॥
3.31.m:
Since you will undoubtedly become renowned by my name.’
Having heard this statement spoken by the great sage Mātaṅga,
saying ‘So be it!’, she vanished, and the sage was delighted.

3.31.s:
mātaṅgasya maharṣestu tasya svapne tadā mudā /
tāpicchamañjarīmekāṃ dadau karṇāvataṃsataḥ //
3.31.d:
मातङ्गस्य महर्षेस्तु तस्य स्वप्ने तदा मुदा ।
तापिच्छमञ्जरीमेकां ददौ कर्णावतंसतः ॥
3.31.m:
Then, in a dream of that great ṛṣi Mātaṅga, she joyfully
gave him a cluster of tāpiccha flowers from her ear ornament.

3.31.s:
tatsvapnasya prabhāveṇa mātaṅgasya sadharmiṇī /
nāmnā siddhimatī garbhe laghuśyāmāmadhārayat //
3.31.d:
तत्स्वप्नस्य प्रभावेण मातङ्गस्य सधर्मिणी ।
नाम्ना सिद्धिमती गर्भे लघुश्यामामधारयत् ॥
3.31.m:
By the power of that dream, the lawful wife of Mātaṅga,
named Siddhimatī, bore Laghuśyāmā in her womb.

3.31.s:
tata eva samutpannā mātaṅgī tena kīrtitāḥ /
laghuśyāmeti sā prokta śyāmā yanmūlakandabhūḥ //
3.31.d:
तत एव समुत्पन्ना मातङ्गी तेन कीर्तिताः ।
लघुश्यामेति सा प्रोक्त श्यामा यन्मूलकन्दभूः ॥
3.31.m:
Because she was born from him, she is celebrated as Mātaṅgī;
she is called Laghuśyāmā because Śyāmā is the root source of her being.

3.31.s:
mātaṅgakanyakā hṛdyāḥ koṭīnāmapi koṭiśaḥ /
laghuśyāmā mahāśyāmāmātaṅgī vṛndasaṃyutāḥ /
aṅgaśaktitvamāpannāḥ sevante priyakapriyām //
3.31.d:
मातङ्गकन्यका हृद्याः कोटीनामपि कोटिशः ।
लघुश्यामा महाश्यामामातङ्गी वृन्दसंयुताः ।
अङ्गशक्तित्वमापन्नाः सेवन्ते प्रियकप्रियाम् ॥
3.31.m:
Tens of millions of charming daughters of Mātaṅga,
accompanied by hosts of Laghuśyāmās, Mahāśyāmās, and Mātaṅgīs,
having attained the status of subsidiary powers, serve the one who loves the priyaka tree.

3.31.s:
iti mātaṅgakanyānāmutpattiḥ kuṃbhasaṃbhava /
kathitāḥ saptakakṣāśca śālā lohādinirmitāḥ //
iti śrībrahmāṇḍamahāpurāṇe uttarabhāge lalitopākhyāne hayagrīvāgastyasaṃvāde saptakakṣyā mataṅgakanyāprādurbhāvo nāmaikatriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
3.31.d:
इति मातङ्गकन्यानामुत्पत्तिः कुंभसंभव ।
कथिताः सप्तकक्षाश्च शाला लोहादिनिर्मिताः ॥
इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डमहापुराणे उत्तरभागे ललितोपाख्याने हयग्रीवागस्त्यसंवादे सप्तकक्ष्या मतङ्गकन्याप्रादुर्भावो नामैकत्रिंशो ऽध्यायः
3.31.m:
Thus, O jar-born one [Agastya], the origin of the daughters of Mātaṅga
has been described, as well as the seven concentric courts and the ramparts built of iron and other materials.

Thus ends the thirty-first chapter, named ‘The Manifestation of the Daughters of Mataṅga in the Seven Courts’, in the dialogue between Hayagrīva and Agastya, in the Lalitopākhyāna, in the latter section of the glorious Brahmāṇḍa Mahāpurāṇa.

3.32.s:
agastya uvāca
lohādisaptaśālānāṃ rakṣakā eva saṃti vai /
tannāmakīrtaya prājña yena me saṃśayacchidā //
3.32.d:
अगस्त्य उवाच
लोहादिसप्तशालानां रक्षका एव संति वै ।
तन्नामकीर्तय प्राज्ञ येन मे संशयच्छिदा ॥

3.32.s:
hayagrīva uvāca
nānāvṛkṣamahodyāne vartate kuṃbhasaṃbhava /
mahākālaḥ sarvalokabhakṣakaḥ śyāmavigrahaḥ //
3.32.d:
हयग्रीव उवाच
नानावृक्षमहोद्याने वर्तते कुंभसंभव ।
महाकालः सर्वलोकभक्षकः श्यामविग्रहः ॥
3.32.m:
Hayagrīva said:
In the great orchard of diverse trees, O jar-born one,
dwells Mahākāla, the devourer of all the worlds, of dark form,

3.32.s:
śyāmakañcukadhārī ca madāruṇavilocanaḥ /
brahmāṇḍacaṣake pūrṇaṃ pibanviśvarasāyanam //
3.32.d:
श्यामकञ्चुकधारी च मदारुणविलोचनः ।
ब्रह्माण्डचषके पूर्णं पिबन्विश्वरसायनम् ॥
3.32.m:
wearing a dark coat of mail, with eyes reddened by intoxication,
drinking the universal elixir filled to the brim in the goblet of the cosmic egg,

3.32.s:
mahākālīṃ ghanaśyāmāmanaṅgārdrāmapāṅgayan /
siṃhāsane samāsīnaḥ kalpānte kalanātmake //
3.32.d:
